english: Doviello Berserkers carry crude weapons into battle, a throwing rock bigger than a man's head or a stout branch. They use these makeshift weapons because they are temporary. The first opponent killed became the weapon of choice. Grabbed by the ankles they would be swung like a meaty flail. Blood sprayed over opponents and every swing would lose more and more of the corpse until another was needed to replace the first. At this point in the battle the "weapons" were always readily available. Occasionally an opponent would be grabbed while still alive. The effect of being beaten by a bloody body that was screaming at you while it happened is traumatizing to even the most hardened warrior. Few armies were willing to face them. -from "Pack of Wolves" by Dentaro
chinese: 多维洛的狂战士带着粗陋的武器上阵——一块比人头还大的投石，或一根粗壮的树枝。他们用这些临时凑合的武器，是因为它们本就是权宜之物。第一个被杀死的对手，便成了他们首选的武器。他们抓住对手的脚踝，像挥舞一根血肉连枷般抡起。鲜血溅在对手身上，每一挥都会甩掉尸体越来越多的部分，直到需要另一具来替换。到了战斗的这个阶段，这样的“武器”总是随手可得。偶尔也会有对手在还活着时被抓起。被一具边挨打边朝你尖叫的血淋淋躯体殴打，即便对最坚韧的战士也是一种创伤。少有军队愿意与他们正面交锋。——摘自登塔罗所著《群狼》

english: [TAB]The Gentle One. The Guardian of the Placid Sea. The Scarecrow of the Coward God. The Neutered-Guard-Dog of the Deep. These are translations of some of the more respectful titles recorded in the Dabrei Tanninim (a hundred scroll chronicle of the Godswar composed three decades before Kylorin's birth, known only from commentaries recovered from the Library fo Barathrum) to refer to a beast whose true name had already been forgotten. [PARAGRAPH:2]While gods and dragons warred across Creation, this creature lay safe at the feet of Danalin, below his throne, guarding against threats to Maenalus that never came. He had been made as a sign (an empty threat, some claimed) that Danalin would defend his beloved Aifons if their armies were ever to encroach upon his sacred waters The Great Scaled Dragon was one of many beasts made for this purpose, but his presence was more imposing than all the rest of his lord's horde. [PARAGRAPH:2]Danalin and Sucellus were not dragged into the Godswar until it neared an end; their armies of beasts, angels, and elementals saw little action. The Great Scaled Dragon fought only 4 days in the war before the great truce. He never turned the tide of a single battle in that age, and rarely dared to lead any assault in person. His greatest claim to fame was that he was the first beast to retreat for the meeting at the Seven Pines, and was the first to leave Erebus after the signing of the Compact. The Aifons once sang praises of his prudence. Men and Elves mocked the monster's cowardice. In Kylorin's early armies, "Scaled Dragon" became the byword for a paper tiger. That would change. [PARAGRAPH:2]Incomprehensible omens, visions, dreams of torment too horrid to describe, and prophecies that left the seers catatonic became almost commonplace during the Patrian Civil War. Many signs pointed to a catastrophe looming over the Aifons, and some even named the date of their demise, but no one knew that threat they faced. Kylorin's former pupil, the Aifon Trenton Majosi, traveled all the lands of Erebus seeking salvation for his people, but found none. The closest he came was uncovering a ritual he was told could summon his god into Erebus itself, to personally protect them from whatever doom awaited them. [PARAGRAPH:2]Midway through performing the ritual, perhaps mesmerized by the pendulum swing of his spear, his mind began to wander, pondering the fate of the friends he had made on his quest. Tears welled up within him. As his chants approached the final stanza, he choked up and fell to his knees, unable to continue. He had realized that his actions would unleash a second Godswar on Creation, putting far more lives in peril than he had hoped to save. [PARAGRAPH:2]His family urged him on, but they knew nothing of the hardships other nations had endured why Danalin protected their ancestors alone. His people had had their golden age, but Majosi knew that Man had been denied theirs by the act of pettier gods. He knew they deserved life more than he did. He said as much, but his apprentice would not listen. The boy grabbed the text and tried to pry the sacred spear from his webbed hands to finish the work, but Majosi hurled it into the depths where it remains unto this day. [PARAGRAPH:2]Trenton prayed that his god let them go that he might learn to care for Humanity as he had the Aifons, but the god was not ready to do so. Unable to personally intervene, Danalin unleashed all his beasts into Creation to guard his children, against he knew not what. Leviathan and the Great Scaled Dragon guarded the Isle from each side, awaiting the morning of the Aifon's predicted demise. [PARAGRAPH:2]No man nor god knows what happened on that morn. No Aifon soul reaches Danalin's vault, Arawn's Netherworld, or any heaven or hell. They simply vanished, or were consumed by something too horrible for words. Of the creatures sent to guard them, only Leviathan and the Scaled Dragon remained, but they were never the same. Driven mad by whatever they saw, these once wise and gentle beasts became the most vicious creatures in Creation. Leviathan was confined to the waves, but the dragon roamed far and wide, leveling cities in his wake. The Fire Rain did not slow him, nor did Mulcarn's entry into Erebus once the Illians found and completed Trenton's ritualn. Some claim that not even the new God of Erebus dared to face him, after seeing him devour the Aquilans he had sent to recruit the beast. [PARAGRAPH:2]His rampage could not last forever. In the twenty-third year since the deep freeze, the Beast met his match in Lucar and his horde. Legends tell of six thousand men of valor who saved the world from this abomination, in a sadly Pyrrhic victory. Lucar's spear struck true, but as the dragon breathed it last its heart burst open with not blood, but the greatest flood of brine ever seen in any land. The army arrayed against him was washed away in the deluge, which rushed down into the valley below, eroding twenty mountains, toppling the last of the Thraxian citadels, and drowning all who lived within. When the waters subsided all signs of civilization had been washed to floor bottom of the Aegean, a sea which is said to have tripled in size on that day. [PARAGRAPH:3]With the resurrection of Acheron, Drifa, and Abashi, rumors spread that this beast too may live again. Some Cultists claim that the Lords of the Aegean demand he be given new life, to drown all the realms of men and make all of Erebus submit to the Masters of the Depths. Mumbling Dreamers have begun to shout "Thalatth!" One Speaker of the Tide has proclaimed this to be the true name of the Crazed Dragon, but none can say for sure.
chinese: [TAB]温柔者。宁海的守护者。懦弱之神的稻草人。深渊那被阉割的看门犬。这些是《达布雷·坦尼宁》（一部记述诸神之战、成书于凯洛林诞生前三十年的百卷编年史，如今仅从巴拉斯鲁姆图书馆寻回的注疏中得知）所记录的、用以指称一头真名早已被遗忘之巨兽的较为恭敬的称号中的几个译名。[PARAGRAPH:2]当诸神与巨龙在造物界各处交战时，这头造物安然卧于达纳林脚下、他的王座之下，守御着那从未降临过的、对梅纳鲁斯的威胁。他被造出来，是作为一个信号（有人说是一个空洞的威胁）：倘若谁的军队胆敢侵犯达纳林的圣水，他必会保卫他挚爱的艾丰人。这头巨大的鳞龙是为此目的所造的众多巨兽之一，但他的存在比其主子麾下其余所有兽群都更为慑人。[PARAGRAPH:2]达纳林与苏塞卢斯直到诸神之战临近尾声才被卷入其中；他们那由巨兽、天使与元素构成的军队几乎未曾出战。这头大鳞龙在大休战之前，一共只在战争中厮杀了 4 天。他在那个时代从未扭转过任何一场战役的战局，也极少敢于亲自率军进攻。他最出名的“功绩”，是他成了第一头为“七松会晤”而撤退的巨兽，也是《契约》签订后第一头离开埃瑞布斯的巨兽。艾丰人曾歌颂他的审慎。人类与精灵则嘲笑这怪物的懦弱。在凯洛林早期的军队里，“鳞龙”成了纸老虎的代名词。而这即将改变。[PARAGRAPH:2]在帕提亚内战期间，无从索解的预兆、异象、恐怖到难以形容的折磨之梦，以及令先知陷入僵直的预言，几乎成了寻常之事。诸多征兆都指向一场即将笼罩艾丰人的浩劫，有些甚至指明了他们覆灭的日期，却无人知晓他们所面临的究竟是何种威胁。凯洛林昔日的门徒、艾丰人特伦顿·玛乔希遍历埃瑞布斯所有的土地，为他的族人寻求救赎，却一无所获。他最接近成功的一次，是发掘出一个仪式——据说它能将他的神明召入埃瑞布斯本土，好亲自保护他们免遭那不知为何的厄运。[PARAGRAPH:2]仪式进行到一半，或许是被他长矛钟摆般的摆动所催眠，他的心神开始游移，思忖起他在这段追寻中结交的朋友们的命运。泪水在他心中涌起。当他的咏唱接近最后一节时，他哽咽着跪倒在地，无法继续。他意识到，自己的举动将在造物界释放第二场诸神之战，令远比他所希望拯救的更多的生命陷入险境。[PARAGRAPH:2]他的家人催促他继续，但他们对其他民族所忍受的苦难一无所知，也不知达纳林为何独独庇护他们的祖先。他的族人已然享有过他们的黄金时代，但玛乔希知道，人类的黄金时代却被那些更卑劣的神明之举所剥夺。他知道，比起他自己，他们更配拥有生命。他把这番话说了出来，但他的学徒不肯听。那男孩抓起经文，试图从他带蹼的手中掰下那神圣的长矛以完成仪式，玛乔希却将它掷入了深渊，它至今仍留在那里。[PARAGRAPH:2]特伦顿祈祷他的神明放过他们，好让他学会像关爱艾丰人那样关爱人类，但那神明还未准备好这么做。无法亲自干预的达纳林，将他所有的巨兽尽数释放到造物界，去守护他的孩子，抵御他自己也不知为何物的东西。深海巨兽与大鳞龙从两侧守卫着那座岛，等待着艾丰人预言中覆灭之晨的到来。[PARAGRAPH:2]没有人、也没有神知道那个清晨发生了什么。没有一个艾丰人的灵魂抵达达纳林的宝库、阿劳恩的冥界，或任何天堂或地狱。他们就那样消失了，或是被某种恐怖到无法言说的东西吞噬了。在被派去守护他们的造物中，只有深海巨兽与鳞龙留存了下来，但他们再也不复从前。被目睹之物逼疯的这两头曾经睿智温和的巨兽，成了造物界最凶残的生物。深海巨兽被困于波涛之间，鳞龙却四处游荡，所过之处夷平城市。“火雨”未能减缓他，伊利安人找到并完成特伦顿的仪式后穆尔卡恩进入埃瑞布斯，也未能阻止他。有人声称，在目睹他吞噬掉自己派去招募这头巨兽的阿奎兰之后，就连埃瑞布斯的新神也不敢与他正面相对。[PARAGRAPH:2]他的暴虐不可能永远持续。在深度冰封后的第二十三年，这头巨兽在卢卡尔及其大军手中遇到了对手。传说讲述了六千名勇士从这怪物手中拯救了世界，那却是一场惨痛的皮洛士式惨胜。卢卡尔的长矛刺中了要害，但当鳞龙吐出最后一口气时，他的心脏迸裂开来，涌出的不是鲜血，而是任何土地上都未曾得见的、最浩大的盐水洪流。列阵与他对抗的军队被这场大洪水冲走，洪水奔涌而下、灌入下方的山谷，侵蚀了二十座山峰，冲垮了最后残存的斯拉克斯人堡垒，淹死了其中所有的居民。当洪水退去时，一切文明的痕迹都被冲到了爱琴海的海底——据说那片海在那一天扩大了三倍。[PARAGRAPH:3]随着阿切隆、德瑞法与阿巴什的复活，谣言四起，说这头巨兽或许也会再度复生。一些狂信徒声称，爱琴海之主们要求赐予他新的生命，好淹没人类的一切国度，让整个埃瑞布斯臣服于深渊之主。喃喃自语的梦者们开始高喊“塔拉斯！”。一位潮汐代言者宣称这才是这头狂龙的真名，但无人能够确证。

english: Adventurers are fearless and versatile heroes, which can upgrade to almost any type of unit. True to their name, they love looking for adventure rather than just doing the jobs they are assigned. Adventurers left in the wilderness may find lairs you never knew existed, and explore them without bothering to ask permission first. They will serve dutifully while fighting in hostile territory, but when left to guard the cities of their homeland they tend to get board and abandon their posts. Although it can be annoying at times, their short attention span can serve you greatly. They keep their old skills even after upgrading to something completely different, thus allowing possibilities like knights that can subdue beasts and summon elementals.
chinese: 冒险者是无所畏惧、多才多艺的英雄，几乎可以升级为任何类型的单位。人如其名，比起循规蹈矩地完成被分派的任务，他们更爱四处寻觅冒险。被留在荒野中的冒险者，或许会找到你从不知道存在的巢穴，并且不屑于事先请求许可便径直探索。他们在敌方领土作战时会尽忠职守，但若被留下守卫本国的城市，则往往会感到无聊而擅离职守。尽管有时令人恼火，他们那三分钟热度的性子也能帮你大忙。即便升级为截然不同的单位，他们仍保留原有的技能，从而造就出诸如能制服野兽、召唤元素的骑士这般的可能。

english: The Aquilan are the Seven Aspects of Mulcarn, powerful True Angels who take the form of great eagles that dwell in the heart of blizzards. Many assume that the aquilan seek out the blizzards, but in truth the blizzards are formed wherever the aquilan are.
chinese: 阿奎兰是穆尔卡恩的七种化身，是化为栖居于暴风雪核心的巨鹰之形的强大真天使。许多人以为阿奎兰会去寻找暴风雪，但事实上，阿奎兰所在之处便会形成暴风雪。

english: Men-at-Arms are the upgrades of Axemen and Swordsmen. Their main role remains the same, primarily conquest of enemy cities. They can upgrade into any of three or four quite different units, so consider your goal when choosing promotions for them.
chinese: 士兵是斧兵与剑士的升级单位。他们的主要职责一如既往，主要是攻占敌方城市。他们可升级为三四种颇为不同的单位之一，因此为他们选择晋升时请考虑你的目标。

english: Colubra
chinese: 蛇人

english: Great Commanders can be used to either recruit units, build a Command Post in a city, or be added to another unit to increase its strength and the rate it gains experience points from combat. The recruit ability offers a quick random assortment of units, but the Command Post tends to have a better long term effect as it adds Great Commander points to the city making getting another all the more likely. A commander that is joined with a unit can always be split from the unit later on and used for other purposes, or joined to a different unit. Commanders may be used instead of Prophets to construct the holy shrines of The Order, The White Hand, and the Cult of the Dragon.
chinese: 大指挥官可用于招募单位、在城市中建造指挥所，或加入另一单位以提升其战斗力及其从战斗中获取经验值的速度。招募能力能快速提供一批随机的单位，但指挥所往往有更好的长期效果，因为它会为城市增加大指挥官点数，使再获得一位的可能性大大提高。加入某单位的指挥官日后总可从该单位分离，用于其他用途，或加入另一个单位。指挥官可代替先知来建造“秩序”、“白手”与“巨龙教派”的圣殿。

english: Counselor
chinese: 抚慰者

english: The teachings of Sirona would never permit the Elohim to exalt or exploit Anger, Rage, and Hatred as the armies of most nations do; using Berserkers goes against everything the Elohim stand for. Instead, they employ Counselors who study anger only in order to help others understand the root causes of their suffering and overcome them. As disciples of Sirona they refuse to harm a living soul, but will defend those in their charge. When demons of anger and wrath roam Erebus, thousands remain sane only thanks to these Counselors.
chinese: 希柔娜的教诲绝不会允许埃洛希姆人像大多数国家的军队那样去推崇或利用愤怒、暴怒与仇恨；使用狂战士违背埃洛希姆人所秉持的一切。取而代之，他们雇用抚慰者，这些人研究愤怒仅仅是为了帮助他人理解其痛苦的根源并加以克服。作为希柔娜的信徒，他们拒绝伤害任何活着的灵魂，但会保护受他们照料之人。当愤怒与暴怒的恶魔游荡于埃瑞布斯时，成千上万的人唯有依靠这些抚慰者才得以保持神智清明。

english: The Elohim Berserker UU serves a very different purpose than most. These defensive-only units can make powerful defenders thanks to their Spirit [LINK=CONCEPT_AFFINITY]affinity[\\LINK], and have all levels of the spirit sphere promotions. They are most useful at calming units driven mad with the arrival of the Avatar of Wrath.
chinese: 埃洛希姆的狂战士独有单位所承担的职责与大多数狂战士截然不同。这些纯防御型单位凭借其精神[LINK=CONCEPT_AFFINITY]亲和[\\LINK]可成为强大的防御者，并拥有精神领域各级晋升。他们最有用之处，是在末日愤怒之灵降临之时安抚那些被逼疯的单位。

english: This special Undertow unit is created from the Drown spell. Whatever mortal is transformed into a Drown keeps its old base strength plus 2 Death Damage. Being undead, it is immune to death and poison damage. More importantly, Drowns gain the ability to move in coastal tiles as easily as on land, and can move through the Oceans too once the Theology tech is known.
chinese: 这个“暗流”特殊单位由“溺死术”法术创造。无论何种凡人被变为溺死，都会保留其原有的基础战斗力，外加 2 点死亡伤害。作为亡灵，它免疫死亡与毒素伤害。更重要的是，溺死获得了在沿海地块中如履平地般移动的能力，并在掌握“神学”科技后还能穿越海洋。

english: Pixie
chinese: 皮克茜

english: Pixies are the least combat oriented summon. They can defend but not attack. They are more useful to help your workers finish improvements or to sacrifice them in cities to hurry production, gain research, or add culture.
chinese: 皮克茜是最不擅长战斗的召唤物。它们能防御却不能攻击。它们更有用之处，是帮助你的工人完成设施，或在城市中将其牺牲以加速生产、获取研究或增添文化。

english: Pixies were created by Amathaon to tend to his gardens. Since Amathaon has retreated from creation they have been left behind and have spread out to any place that features beautiful flowers. Pixies have some magical powers but they mostly relate to simple illusions or the health of plants. They tend to distrust humans except for small children, who they sometimes protect or play with. One or two pixies sometimes abandon their gardens and move into more populated areas, preferring to live in the homes of artists or inventors. They are fascinated by new creations and are known to help with designs and projects when the artist is away or sleeping.
chinese: 皮克茜由阿玛索恩创造，用以照料他的花园。自阿玛索恩隐退出造物界后，它们便被留了下来，散布到任何有美丽花朵的地方。皮克茜拥有一些魔法之力，但大多与简单的幻象或植物的健康有关。它们往往不信任人类，唯独例外的是幼童，它们有时会保护幼童或与之嬉戏。偶尔会有一两个皮克茜舍弃它们的花园，迁入人烟更稠密之处，偏爱住在艺术家或发明家的家中。它们着迷于新的造物，并且据说会在艺术家离开或熟睡时帮忙进行设计与工程。

english: For here, apart, dwells one whose hands have wrought[NEWLINE]Strange eidola that chill the world with fear;[NEWLINE]Whose graven runes in tomes of dread have taught[NEWLINE]What things beyond the star-gulfs lurk and leer. [NEWLINE]Dark Lord of Averoigne-whose windows stare[NEWLINE]On pits of dream no other gaze could bear!"[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Eidola serve no master but willingly enlist in any deadly conflict. Good religions shun these demonic creatures, or seek them out for destruction, but those who tolerate their vile presence find them to be fearless, deadly warriors, nearly unmatched on any battlefield. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Only evil players can build Eidola.
chinese: 唯此处，遗世独居，有一双手曾造就[NEWLINE]令世界因惧而寒的诡异幻影；[NEWLINE]他镌于恐怖典籍中的符文，昭示[NEWLINE]星渊之外潜伏窥伺的种种之物。[NEWLINE]阿弗洛涅的黑暗之主——他的窗牖凝望[NEWLINE]无他人目光所能承受的梦之深渊！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]幻影死灵不侍奉任何主子，却甘愿投身于任何致命的冲突。善良的宗教避之唯恐不及，或搜寻它们加以摧毁，但那些容忍其邪恶存在的人，会发现它们是无所畏惧、致命的战士，在任何战场上都几乎无可匹敌。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]只有邪恶玩家才能建造幻影死灵。

english: Eidola are demon disciple units that offer alternate upgrades for Champions and Priests. They require Iron or Mithril and an evil alignment, but no specific building. Priest upgraded to Eidola keep their spells, and melee upgraded to Eidola keep any melee-only promotions they have acquired, so consider upgrading rather than building directly. In any case, they're multi-use units with high strength and free march promotion.
chinese: 幻影死灵是恶魔信徒单位，为冠军斗士与祭司提供了另一种升级途径。它们需要铁或秘银以及邪恶阵营，但不需要特定建筑。升级为幻影死灵的祭司保留其法术，升级为幻影死灵的近战单位保留其已获得的任何近战专属晋升，因此不妨考虑升级而非直接建造。无论如何，它们都是战斗力高、且免费拥有“行军”晋升的多用途单位。

english: The High Priests of the Empyrean, the Luminaries, have all the abilities of Vicars as well as being able to use the [LINK=literal]Crown of Brilliance[\\LINK] spell. The crown does damage to all surrounding enemies and allows the caster to see invisible units.
chinese: “天空”的高阶祭司——光耀者——拥有喻所祭司的全部能力，并能使用[LINK=literal]璀璨之冠[\\LINK]法术。此冠对周围所有敌人造成伤害，并让施法者能看见隐形单位。

chinese: 冰魔像

english: The Illian Immortals have been given the same blessing and curse as the late Archangel of Ice, Taranis, in order to fill the role of the late archangel under the reign of the new God of Ice. Upon their ascension it becomes impossible to injure them, but equally impossible for them to grow, learn, or adapt to changing situations.
chinese: 伊利安的不朽战士被赋予了与已故冰之大天使塔拉尼斯相同的祝福与诅咒，以在新任冰之神的统治下填补这位已故大天使的位置。他们飞升之后，便无法被伤害，但同样也无法成长、学习或适应变化的处境。

english: Iron Golems are likely to form the bulk of a Luchuirp army. They have high strength but as golems will not gain promotions from combat. They aren't going to end up as powerful as a highly promoted Man-at-Arms, but losing any one particular iron golem isn't likely to be a huge setback.
chinese: 铁魔像很可能构成鲁崔尔普军队的主力。它们战斗力高，但作为魔像不会从战斗中获得晋升。它们最终不会像一个高度晋升的士兵那样强大，但损失任何一个特定的铁魔像也不太可能是巨大的挫折。

english: Lightbringers have all the abilities of ordinary [LINK=UNIT_DISCIPLE_EMPYREAN]Ecclesiastics[\\LINK] and more. Their [LINK=PROMOTION_PERFECT_SIGHT]Perfect Sight[\\LINK] lets them see invisible units. Like more advanced [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]Empyrean[\\LINK] units, they can help thwart rival spies. More importantly, they have no building requirement, a lower tech requirement, and double the chance to successfully spread the [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN] the Empyrean[\\LINK]. This gives the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MALAKIM]Malakim[\\LINK] a significant head start in founding and popularizing that faith.
chinese: 光明使者拥有普通[LINK=UNIT_DISCIPLE_EMPYREAN]天空使者[\\LINK]的一切能力，且更胜一筹。他们的[LINK=PROMOTION_PERFECT_SIGHT]完美视觉[\\LINK]让他们能看见隐形单位。与更高阶的[LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]天空[\\LINK]单位一样，他们能帮助挫败敌方间谍。更重要的是，他们没有建筑需求，科技需求更低，且成功传播[LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]天空[\\LINK]的几率翻倍。这让[LINK=CIVILIZATION_MALAKIM]马拉基姆[\\LINK]在创立并普及该信仰上占得显著先机。

english: Sluagh
chinese: 游魂

english: Sluagh are the souls of mortals who have died by not yet departed the world of Erebus. The gods send angels or demons to claim the spirits of their most devout followers, but most are left to wander the plane until they find passage to Arawn's realm. The draw of The Otherworld is strong, but can be resisted. A sluagh may long haunt an area if it feels a strong sense of duty to remain, but lingering too long is healthy for neither the spirit nor the world. These spirits often fall victim to evil necromancers, who raise them as undead monstrosities bound to follow the necromancer's will instead of its own. Only a few heroic souls have the strength of will to maintain their sanity, sense of identity, and the hope for a true resurrection. Resurrection spells cannot reach beyond the caster's own plane to restore any soul that has already entered its god's vaults. The Elohim obviate this restriction by assigning a soul catcher to their monarchs. A soul catcher is a mage specializing in spirit magic who can trap the soul after death and hold it until a resurrection is available. A god can answer prayers to send souls they have claimed back to Erebus for resurrection, but this is exceedingly rare. The only known examples are Duin Halfmorn and Arthendain, who were sent back by Camulos and Sucellus respectively.
chinese: 游魂是已死却尚未离开埃瑞布斯世界的凡人灵魂。诸神会派天使或恶魔来索取其最虔诚信徒的灵魂，但大多数灵魂都被留下，在这个位面游荡，直到找到通往阿劳恩国度的通路。冥界的牵引力很强，却可以抗拒。若一个游魂感到强烈的留守之责，它可能会长久萦绕于某地，但滞留太久对灵魂与世界都无益。这些灵魂常常沦为邪恶死灵法师的猎物，被复生为受缚于死灵法师意志、而非自身意志的亡灵怪物。只有少数英勇的灵魂拥有足够坚强的意志，能保持其神智、身份认同以及对真正复活的希望。复活法术无法越过施法者自身所在的位面，去让任何已经进入其神明宝库的灵魂复原。埃洛希姆人通过为其君主指派一名“捕魂者”来规避这一限制。捕魂者是专精精神魔法的法师，能在死后捕获灵魂并将其留存，直至有复活的时机。神明可以回应祈祷，将他们所索取的灵魂送回埃瑞布斯以供复活，但这极为罕见。已知仅有的例子是杜因·哈夫蒙与阿森丹，他们分别被卡穆洛斯与苏塞卢斯送了回来。

english: Laroth
chinese: 拉洛斯

english: The Luonnotar are the most powerful disciple units to which the Grigori have access. Although they lack the spell abilities of priests and high priests, they are immune to magic, very strong in combat against other disciples, and can target disciple units in stacks with better defenders. They can move through rival territory without open border agreements, evangelizing the Children of The One religion to cities and units alike. Priests who adopt their faith are defrocked-- automatically disbanded. Other converts gain Scourge and Magis Resistance. In cities the faith can cause Monotheist revolts, forcing out other religions. Even state religions can be removed, plunging the city into chaos. The Grigori get a free Luonnotar when they first learn Arcane Lore, and can use it to found the Children of The One.
chinese: 天母审判官是格利高里所能获得的最强大的信徒单位。尽管他们不具备祭司与高阶祭司的法术能力，却免疫魔法，对抗其他信徒时战斗力极强，并能锁定处于有更强防御者的堆叠中的信徒单位。他们无需开放边境协议即可穿越敌方领土，向城市与单位一并宣扬“太一之子”宗教。改信其信仰的祭司会被褫夺神职——自动解散。其他皈依者则获得“天罚”与“魔法抵抗”。在城市中，此信仰可引发一神论暴动，逼退其他宗教。就连国教也可能被移除，令城市陷入混乱。格利高里在首次习得“奥秘知识”时会免费获得一名天母审判官，并可用它来创立“太一之子”。

chinese: 狙击手

english: Monks are great for fighting demonic units. They also have the Medic promotion, making them decent healers. They don't need a building to train so they can be created in any city. They have Spirit [LINK=CONCEPT_AFFINITY]affinity[\\LINK], making them extremely powerful if you control eough of that mana. .

english: Radiant Guards have several advantages over axemen. They can see invisible, they start with the Guardsman promotion (allowing them to protect stacks from assassins and marksmen), and they can cast the Blinding Light spell to hold enemies in place. They can upgrade into Men-at-Arms or Rathas, which have all the strenghs of Chariots and more. They do not require Training Yards but do require both the Empyrean religion and a Fenestran Temple to be present in the city. They normally require the Empyrean state religion too, but the Overcouncil may pass a resolution allowing its members to ignore that restriction.
chinese: 光辉守卫相较斧兵有几项优势。他们能看见隐形，起始便拥有“护卫”晋升（使其能保护堆叠免受刺客与神射手攻击），并能施放“致盲之光”法术将敌人钉在原地。他们可升级为士兵或光辉战车（后者拥有战车的全部长处，且更胜一筹）。他们不需要“训练场”，但需要城中同时存在“天空”宗教与一座“芬内斯特兰神庙”。他们通常还需要“天空”国教，但“上议会”可通过决议，允许其成员无视该限制。

english: Rathas have several advantages over chariots. They can see invisible, they can cast the Blinding Light spell to hold enemies in place, and they have an a combat advantage against and the ability to target the sort of units which are enemies of Lugus. They may be trained only by those with the Empyrean as their state religion in cities where that faith and its temples are present.
chinese: 光辉战车相较战车有几项优势。他们能看见隐形，能施放“致盲之光”法术将敌人钉在原地，并对卢古斯之敌一类的单位拥有战斗优势及锁定能力。他们只能由以“天空”为国教者、在该信仰及其神庙均存在的城市中训练。

english: Rathus Denmora has all the abilities of both [LINK=UNIT_GHOST]Ghosts[\\LINK] and [LINK=UNIT_DIVIDED_SOUL]Divided Souls[\\LINK], but his true value is as the ultimate counter other [LINK=PROMOTION_HERO]heroes[\\LINK]. He specifically targets heroes in stacks of stronger units (except in cities), and starts with the [LINK=EQUIPMENT_NETHER_BLADE]Nether Blade[\\LINK]. This otherworldly sword guarantees victory against heroes, and makes its victims ineligible for resurrection until the equipment is destroyed.
chinese: 暗影行者拉萨斯·邓莫拉拥有[LINK=UNIT_GHOST]幽灵[\\LINK]与[LINK=UNIT_DIVIDED_SOUL]裂灵[\\LINK]二者的全部能力，但他真正的价值在于作为其他[LINK=PROMOTION_HERO]英雄[\\LINK]的终极克星。他专门锁定处于更强单位堆叠中的英雄（城市中除外），且起始便持有[LINK=EQUIPMENT_NETHER_BLADE]冥狱之刃[\\LINK]。这柄异界之剑保证对英雄战无不胜，并使其受害者在该装备被摧毁之前无法被复活。

The Astral Body has the Call Form ability, which summons its physical body to its tile and deletes the unit. (This cannot be used when they are already on the same tile.) The Astral Body is deleted when its body is killed. (Due to limitations in the code, it must also be deleted when its summoner upgrades to another unit. )

english: [TAB]How many roles have I played? They blur together in my mind. [PARAGRAPH:1]I was a victim from the moment my life began. An attacker came for my mother even as she gave birth to me. He possessed Garrus, a simple stable boy and used him to sneak up through the inn to my parents' room. He tried to get close to my mother, to attack her at her most vulnerable. My father fought to stop him. The details are unknown except that a battle occurred in the room and my father was struck a mortal blow. With his last breath he uttered a holy word that destroyed the spirit possessing Garrus and collapsed the entire inn. [PARAGRAPH:1]My mother died in the collapse, my father died from the attack. The stable boy was pulled from the rubble, one arm was crushed but he appeared otherwise healthy. My soul fled the dying infants form and took home in his newly evacuated body. I was born into the body of a teenage boy. [PARAGRAPH:1]The innkeeper raised me, teaching me as if I had simply forgotten my life and in a few years I served him well. He raised me as he rebuilt the inn. But I always knew that Garrus wasn't my name and I listened intently when those that survived the collapse retold the story. [PARAGRAPH:1]We didn't know much about my parents, but my father wore the yellow robes of a priest of the Empyrean. There was a small temple to the god in our city and when I was ready I joined their ranks as a disciple. Within the clergy my identity didn't matter, I was simply a child of Lugus. My superiors praised my empathy, questioned my maturity and laughed when I said that I thought I was the son of a priest. They claimed no such priest had visited the city and considered my thoughts the wishful thoughts of boy with too much imagination. [PARAGRAPH:1]My right arm was still crushed. By this point it was shriveled and permanently wrapped against my side. When I asked if it could be healed the priests prayed over it, but it never got better. Others came and received healing, nobles, merchants, beggars, soldiers, but I remained maimed. [PARAGRAPH:1]One day in early Aedrini the temple was in an uproar. Priests barked orders, disciples scurried about trying to look busy. No one had thought to wake me. After many questions a priest finally gave me my answer. [PARAGRAPH:1]"The Luminary Chalid is coming child, so stay out of the way. "[PARAGRAPH:1]I began to retreat to my chamber when he yelled after me, "And don't bother him when he arrives!"[PARAGRAPH:1]That next day a single man arrived on a dappled grey mare. He rode without an escort and though he needed no guards on the road, he could have used some outside of the temple. He was immediately mobbed by well meaning disciples, genuflecting priests and hordes of gawking townspeople. He wore the robes of a Luminary and I wondered if my father wore the same. [PARAGRAPH:1]He spent the next three days in our hastily constructed council chamber. The chamber was open for anyone to hear the deliberation and speak in an orderly manner. They discussed the towns role in the Overcouncil, local legislation and a problem with brigands in the area. [PARAGRAPH:1]The council meetings always went well into the night, and Chalid attended every dawn ceremony. He only had a few hours between to get some sleep. I was hurrying to the dawn service one morning when I found him standing alone in the refectory looking out the windows toward the east. The morning bell rung, signaling the dawn ceremony was about to start and Chalid turned to find me staring at him. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Morning disciple, are you ready to receive our lords blessing?"[PARAGRAPH:1]I managed to stammer something unintelligible out. Despite that he smiled at me with true affection and clasped me on the shoulder. That was the first he noticed my withered arm. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Do you have something to ask me?" he said. [PARAGRAPH:1]He expected me to ask for healing, but that didn't matter to me. Instead I asked, "What sort of spirit attacked my mother?"[PARAGRAPH:1]He put his arm around me and we walked to the sanctuary together. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Let me pray about it" he said. [PARAGRAPH:1]The service was exactly like all the others but I paid little attention. Instead I watched Chalid. He looked confused as he prayed, sometimes pained, sometimes resigned and I imagined that it had something to do with my question. [PARAGRAPH:1]I waited after the service. Chalid spoke briefly with the vicar who had performed the service and meet a few of the members. Then he left the sanctuary and went into the council chambers. [PARAGRAPH:1]I spent the day neglecting my duties and waiting outside the council chamber. Just past nightfall the towns warning bells rang out; guards ran through the streets yelling that brigands were attacking. [PARAGRAPH:1]Everyone flooded out of the temple. At the edge of the town shapes rushed through the darkness. Black tipped arrows cut guards down where they writhed screaming in pain. Guards brought torches and under the cover of shield men they retook the fortifications while the shadows simply moved to attack at another point. [PARAGRAPH:1]A voice from the darkness called, "What good is a god that abandons you every night?"[PARAGRAPH:1]Chalid ignored the taunt and ordered the men back within the cities lantern light. He alone bounded over the wall and in to the darkness at the cities edge. His mace glowed faintly in the starlight and though we couldn't see any attackers on the open field we all knew they were moving in on him. [PARAGRAPH:1]Chalid prayed and an aura of golden fire burst up around his head and dark men caught fire on the field, on the walls, and even a few that had snuck into the city. The holy fire consumed them and guards rushed in to beat or capture the men. [PARAGRAPH:1]But one was not distracted by the fire. It clung to his black armor and that of his steed but he rode soundlessly towards Chalid, like a shadow of a dark god stretching out to touch him. Chalid raised his mace up, and then back down and the field was lit up as if it was day. A pillar of golden fire, like the sun itself but full of righteous fury, crushed the rider. There was a horrific scream and then when the pillar retreated back up into the sky the rider was gone. [PARAGRAPH:1]I spent the night tending to the guardsmen wounded in the attack. Their wounds festered from poison and the men passed between fevered dreams and anguish when awake. There was little I could do but try to keep their wounds clean and try to make them comfortable. Chalid and the priests prayed over the men and some were healed, but too many were injured. [PARAGRAPH:1]That next morning I returned to my chambers to wash up and change into fresh clothes, as did most of the temple. I headed again to the dawn ceremony and found Chalid alone again in the refectory looking out towards the east. [PARAGRAPH:1]"You saved the town. " It sounded hollow when I said it. Unsuited to the miracle I had witnessed. [PARAGRAPH:1]"I only had faith that Lugus would protect me, he did everything else. "[PARAGRAPH:1]I smiled, the warmth Chalid had shared with me yesterday was gone now. He looked troubled but I assumed it was just the events of the long night. I know he hadn't slept either. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Did you find out anything about my mother?"[PARAGRAPH:1]Chalid looked at the floor, the morning bells rang though neither of us moved. [PARAGRAPH:1]"I should lie to you" Chalid said, "the mandate of truth is sometimes painful. I am sorry. I won't lie but I will warn you, it would be better if you did not know. "[PARAGRAPH:1]"I want to know" I argued with more passion than I intended, "Knowledge, truth, revelation are the precepts of Lugus. I should know my own past. "[PARAGRAPH:1]"The woman's name was Magda de'Vala" Chalid started, "The man wasn't her husband but her guardian, though he was a priest of the Empyrean. The child was prophesied to be a great hero, which is why many sought to kill Magda and her baby. "[PARAGRAPH:1]He paused, but I only waited for him to continue. [PARAGRAPH:1]"The stable boy Garrus died three days before the attack. That which killed Garrus, that which killed Magda's guardian and caused the collapse that killed Magda and her baby. that was you. "[PARAGRAPH:1]I was furious and I rushed out of the refectory. Chalid watched me go then headed into the sanctuary. My thoughts went back to those early days. I never felt like I was the stable boy. And for the first time I questioned my origin. Would a baby's spirit in a boy's body be able to adapt that quickly? Could even a possessed stable boy be able to overcome a priest of Lugus, or was that creature something darker? And was I that creature?[PARAGRAPH:1]I stopped in the temples infirmary. Except for the wounded it was empty, everyone in the temple was in the dawn ceremony despite those laying here near death. There was only one man awake, a bandage covered his left thigh. I knelt at his bedside. When I saw the torment he was in I forgot a bit of my own. [PARAGRAPH:1]"What is your name?" I asked. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Abin," he said, "I'm a jeweler who pretended to be a city guard. "[PARAGRAPH:1]That wasn't unusual. Our city was too small to maintain full time guardsmen so most were volunteers with other jobs. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Either you are too good at pretending, or not good enough. "[PARAGRAPH:1]He gave me a weak smile. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Can I pray for you?" I asked. He nodded. [PARAGRAPH:1]I placed my hand on him and closed my eyes. I have seen many healed but I had never performed a miracle myself. If I could do this, if I could heal this man and channel the power of Lugus then I couldn't be whatever creature Chalid thought I was. Maybe I was the holy child, maybe the attack on Magda de'Vala failed. [PARAGRAPH:1]I could feel his labored breath. I could feel his pain, feel his love for his large family of nieces and nephews. His quiet store and hours spent working on small intricate jewelry. And I felt him die. [PARAGRAPH:1]Then I felt the poison strike, it burnt through my body focused on the wound in my left thigh. I stepped away from the bed in shock. I was taller and my robes, which were big on me, were now tight. And my formerly withered arm was now trapped uncomfortably in its folds. [PARAGRAPH:1]I loosened the robe and held out my full, strong arm. But it didn't look like my arm; it was the jewelers arm. As I looked at myself I realized that I was identical to the dead body of the jeweler that lay in the bed in front of me. And then the poison struck again and sent me to my knees. I picked myself up and fled the temple in pain and confusion. [PARAGRAPH:1]Pain will drive you mad and it only took a few hours of suffering like this before I found a farmer out working in his field. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Blind goats Abin!" he said, "what is wrong with you? Why are you wearing a disciple's robes?"[PARAGRAPH:1]I threw him to the ground and held him, smashing him once in the face when he tried to fight back. I felt for that closeness, I reached out to find everything that he was, and the pain drifted away. When I opened my eyes I saw him staring up at his own reflection in horror. The last I saw him he was running toward his farmhouse, I started running as well. I don't think I have ever stopped. [NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:1]I still don't know what I am. All the roles that I've played since then blur together in my mind. I've gotten better at reading people and worked for a time for an assassins' guild, simply for reading people I touch. During other times I steal the lives of those I wish to share. I tried the lavish extravagance of princes and wealthy merchants, but there is little to envy them for once you understand how they truly live. The best stolen lives come from the simple fathers of large families, those that have the love and respect of everyone in their lives. Dump the body of one of those in a shallow grave and I have a few good weeks of fun before I become bored and move on to something else. [PARAGRAPH:1]Maybe Chalid was right, maybe I am a monster.

[TAB]我扮演过多少个角色？它们在我心中模糊成一片。[PARAGRAPH:1]从生命伊始的那一刻起，我便是个受害者。就在母亲分娩生下我的当口，一名袭击者朝她而来。他附身于加勒斯——一个头脑简单的马厩男孩——用他潜过旅店，来到我父母的房间。他试图接近我母亲，在她最脆弱之时下手。我父亲奋力阻止他。除了房中曾发生一场搏斗、父亲身受致命一击之外，细节已无从知晓。他以最后一口气吐出一个圣言，摧毁了附身加勒斯的灵魂，并令整座旅店坍塌。[PARAGRAPH:1]母亲死于坍塌，父亲死于那场袭击。马厩男孩被人从瓦砾中拖出，一条手臂被压碎，但除此之外看似健康。我的灵魂逃离了垂死婴儿的躯体，栖入了他那新近腾空的身体。我诞生在了一个少年的身体里。[PARAGRAPH:1]旅店老板抚养我长大，教导我时只当我不过是忘记了自己的过往，几年之内我便把他伺候得很好。他一边重建旅店，一边把我养大。但我始终知道加勒斯不是我的名字，每当坍塌事故的幸存者重述那个故事时，我都会凝神细听。[PARAGRAPH:1]我们对我父母所知不多，但我父亲身着“天空”祭司的黄袍。我们城里有一座献给这位神明的小神庙，等我准备好后，我便作为一名信徒加入了他们的行列。在教士团中，我的身份无关紧要，我不过是卢古斯的一个孩子。我的上级称赞我的共情，质疑我的成熟，并在我说自己觉得自己是一位祭司之子时哈哈大笑。他们声称从没有这样一位祭司到访过本城，认为我的想法不过是个想象力过剩的男孩一厢情愿的空想。[PARAGRAPH:1]我的右臂依旧残废。到此时它已萎缩，永久地绑缚在我身侧。当我问它是否能被治愈时，祭司们为它祈祷，它却始终不见好转。别人来了，都得到了治愈——贵族、商人、乞丐、士兵——唯独我依旧残疾。[PARAGRAPH:1]埃德里尼月初的一天，神庙里一片喧腾。祭司们厉声下令，信徒们东奔西走、装作忙碌。没有人想到叫醒我。问了许多遍之后，一位祭司终于给了我答案。[PARAGRAPH:1]“光耀者卡利德要来了，孩子，所以别碍事。”[PARAGRAPH:1]我正要退回自己的房间，他在身后朝我喊道：“还有，他到了以后别去打扰他！”[PARAGRAPH:1]第二天，一个男子独自骑着一匹带斑纹的灰色母马来到。他一路无人护送，虽然赶路时他不需要卫士，在神庙外却本该用得上几个。他立刻被善意的信徒、屈膝行礼的祭司和一群群看热闹的镇民团团围住。他身着光耀者的长袍，我不禁猜想我父亲是否也曾穿着同样的袍子。[PARAGRAPH:1]接下来三天，他都待在我们仓促搭建的议事厅里。议事厅对所有人开放，人人都可旁听审议，并按规矩有序发言。他们讨论着本镇在“上议会”中的角色、本地立法，以及本地区的一桩盗匪问题。[PARAGRAPH:1]议事总要持续到深夜，而卡利德每一场破晓仪式都会出席。其间他只有几个小时能睡上一觉。一天清晨，我正匆匆赶去参加破晓礼拜，却发现他独自站在餐厅里，望着窗外东方。晨钟响起，示意破晓仪式即将开始，卡利德转过身，发现我正盯着他看。[PARAGRAPH:1]“早安，信徒，你准备好领受我们主的祝福了吗？”[PARAGRAPH:1]我勉强含糊地嘟囔了几句。尽管如此，他仍带着真挚的慈爱朝我微笑，拍了拍我的肩膀。那是他第一次注意到我萎缩的手臂。[PARAGRAPH:1]“你有什么想问我的吗？”他说。[PARAGRAPH:1]他以为我会请求治愈，但那对我并不重要。相反，我问：“是什么样的灵魂袭击了我母亲？”[PARAGRAPH:1]他搂住我的肩，我们一同走向圣所。[PARAGRAPH:1]“让我为此祈祷一番。”他说。[PARAGRAPH:1]那场礼拜与其他所有礼拜别无二致，但我几乎没在留意，而是一直望着卡利德。他祈祷时神情困惑，时而痛苦，时而无奈，我猜想这与我的问题有关。[PARAGRAPH:1]礼拜结束后我等着他。卡利德与主持礼拜的喻所祭司简短交谈了几句，又见了几位成员。然后他离开圣所，走进了议事厅。[PARAGRAPH:1]那一整天我都疏忽了自己的职责，守在议事厅外等待。刚过入夜，镇上的警钟骤然响起；卫兵奔过街道，高喊盗匪来袭。[PARAGRAPH:1]所有人从神庙涌出。镇子边缘，黑影在暗中疾掠。黑镞箭矢射倒了卫兵，他们痛苦地扭动尖叫。卫兵举来火把，在持盾者的掩护下夺回了工事，而那些黑影只是转往另一处发动进攻。[PARAGRAPH:1]黑暗中一个声音喊道：“一个每夜都抛弃你的神，又有什么用？”[PARAGRAPH:1]卡利德无视这挑衅，下令众人退回城市的灯光之内。唯有他独自翻过城墙，跃入城边的黑暗。他的钉锤在星光下微微发亮，虽然我们在旷野上看不见任何袭击者，我们都知道他们正朝他围拢。[PARAGRAPH:1]卡利德祈祷，一圈金色火焰在他头顶迸然腾起，黑衣人在旷野上、在城墙上、乃至几个潜入城中的，都燃起火来。圣火将他们吞噬，卫兵冲上去痛击或俘获这些人。[PARAGRAPH:1]但有一个人没有被火焰扰乱。火焰缠附在他和他坐骑的黑甲上，他却无声地朝卡利德骑来，宛如一位黑暗之神的影子伸展开来要触碰他。卡利德举起钉锤，随即挥落，旷野瞬间亮如白昼。一道金色火焰的巨柱，如太阳本身却满含正义的怒火，将那骑手碾碎。传来一声骇人的尖叫，待火柱退回天空时，那骑手已消失无踪。[PARAGRAPH:1]那一夜我都在照料袭击中受伤的卫兵。他们的伤口因毒而溃烂，那些人在高烧的梦魇与清醒时的痛苦间辗转。我能做的不多，只能设法让他们的伤口保持洁净，尽量让他们舒服些。卡利德与祭司们为这些人祈祷，有些得到了治愈，但受伤的人太多了。[PARAGRAPH:1]第二天清晨，我回到自己的房间梳洗、换上干净衣裳，神庙里大多数人也如此。我再度前往破晓仪式，又发现卡利德独自在餐厅里望着东方。[PARAGRAPH:1]“你拯救了这座镇子。”我说出口时，这话听起来空洞无力，配不上我所目睹的奇迹。[PARAGRAPH:1]“我只是坚信卢古斯会保护我，其余一切都是他做的。”[PARAGRAPH:1]我笑了，昨日卡利德与我分享的那份温情此刻已然消散。他神情困扰，但我以为那只是漫漫长夜诸事所致。我知道他也没睡。[PARAGRAPH:1]“你查到我母亲的什么了吗？”[PARAGRAPH:1]卡利德望着地面，晨钟响起，我们却都没有动。[PARAGRAPH:1]“我本该对你撒谎，”卡利德说，“真相的箴规有时是痛苦的。我很抱歉。我不会撒谎，但我要警告你，你若不知道会更好。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“我想知道，”我争辩道，语气比我本意更为激烈，“知识、真相、启示，是卢古斯的箴规。我应当知道自己的过去。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“那女人名叫玛格达·德瓦拉，”卡利德开口道，“那男人不是她的丈夫，而是她的守护者，尽管他是一位‘天空’祭司。那孩子被预言将成为一位伟大的英雄，正因如此，许多人想杀死玛格达和她的婴儿。”[PARAGRAPH:1]他顿了顿，我却只等着他继续。[PARAGRAPH:1]“马厩男孩加勒斯在袭击发生前三天就已经死了。那个杀死加勒斯、杀死玛格达守护者、并引发那场害死玛格达及其婴儿的坍塌的东西……那就是你。”[PARAGRAPH:1]我怒不可遏，冲出了餐厅。卡利德目送我离去，然后走进圣所。我的思绪回到了早年那些日子。我从不觉得自己是那个马厩男孩。而我第一次质疑起自己的来历。一个婴儿的灵魂寄居在男孩的身体里，能那么快就适应吗？就算是被附身的马厩男孩，又能否战胜一位卢古斯的祭司，抑或那生物是某种更黑暗之物？而我，就是那个生物吗？[PARAGRAPH:1]我在神庙的医务室停下脚步。除了伤者，这里空无一人——尽管这里躺着濒死之人，神庙里的所有人都在参加破晓仪式。只有一个人醒着，一条绷带缠着他的左大腿。我跪在他床边。当我看到他所受的折磨时，我忘却了一些自己的痛苦。[PARAGRAPH:1]“你叫什么名字？”我问。[PARAGRAPH:1]“阿宾，”他说，“我是个珠宝匠，假扮成城市卫兵。”[PARAGRAPH:1]这并不稀奇。我们城太小，养不起全职卫兵，所以大多数都是有别的营生的志愿者。[PARAGRAPH:1]“你要么假扮得太好，要么还不够好。”[PARAGRAPH:1]他向我勉强一笑。[PARAGRAPH:1]“我能为你祈祷吗？”我问。他点了点头。[PARAGRAPH:1]我把手放在他身上，闭上双眼。我见过许多人被治愈，却从未亲手施行过奇迹。倘若我能做到这个，倘若我能治好这个人、引导卢古斯的力量，那我便不可能是卡利德所以为的那种生物。也许我就是那个圣童，也许对玛格达·德瓦拉的袭击失败了。[PARAGRAPH:1]我能感觉到他艰难的呼吸。我能感觉到他的痛楚，感觉到他对自己那一大家子外甥侄儿的爱。他那安静的店铺，还有伏案打磨精巧细致珠宝的时光。而我，感觉到了他的死亡。[PARAGRAPH:1]随后我感到毒素袭来，它灼烧着我的身体，集中在我左大腿的伤口上。我震惊地从床边退开。我变高了，我那本来宽松的长袍此刻紧绷起来。而我原先萎缩的手臂，如今别扭地困在袍褶之中。[PARAGRAPH:1]我松开长袍，伸出那条完整、强健的手臂。但它看起来不像我的手臂；那是珠宝匠的手臂。当我端详自己时，我意识到自己与眼前床上那具珠宝匠的尸体一模一样。随后毒素再度袭来，令我双膝跪地。我撑起身子，在痛苦与困惑中逃离了神庙。[PARAGRAPH:1]痛苦会把人逼疯，像这样受苦仅仅几个小时后，我便找到一个在田里劳作的农夫。[PARAGRAPH:1]“瞎眼的山羊啊，阿宾！”他说，“你怎么了？你怎么穿着信徒的袍子？”[PARAGRAPH:1]我把他掀翻在地按住，他试图反抗时，我照他脸上狠揍了一拳。我探寻那份亲近，我伸出手去找寻他的一切，痛苦便渐渐消散。当我睁开眼时，我看见他惊恐地仰望着自己的倒影。我最后一次看见他时，他正朝自家农舍奔去，我也跑了起来。我想我从未停下过。[NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:1]我至今仍不知道自己是什么。此后我扮演过的所有角色，都在我心中模糊成一片。我越来越擅长看透人心，曾为一个刺客公会效力过一段时间，仅仅因为能看透我所触碰之人。别的时候，我则窃取那些我想体验的人的生命。我尝试过王公与富商的奢靡铺张，但一旦你明白他们真正是如何生活的，便没什么值得羡慕的了。最好的偷来的生命，来自那些子女成群的朴实父亲，那些赢得了生命中每个人爱戴与敬重的人。把这样一个人的尸体丢进浅坟，我便能痛快几周，直到厌倦，转而去做别的事。[PARAGRAPH:1]也许卡利德是对的，也许我就是个怪物。

english: The Empyrean is the youngest major faith in Erebus, having been organized only by its current Patriarch. The worship of the God of Light, however, is truly ancient. There were temples built in what would later become the Desert of Myrh which survived the worst of the Godswar, yet none survived the Age of Magic. [PARAGRAPH:1]Lanthus was a young Acolyte of Lugus from a time before the kingdoms of Man were first united. He was a righteous boy who lived a peaceful life of service to his community, until the day he met Alexis. In her quest to find immortality, she committed acts against him more egregious than any yet committed by mortal against mortal. She tortured him past the point that a living soul could bare, but would not let him die. When the finally had enough and decided to let is spirit leave his flesh, she devoured it and denied him the eternal rest that his god would have granted. Lugus is a forgiving lord, but even his forgiveness has bounds. He insists on actual repentance, on true contrition. Alexis could not find it in her heart to regret anything, but rejoiced in her inequity and proudly spread the secret of her dark arts to others just as cruel. Where all compassion had failed, Lugus considered it his duty to supplement the conscience, and so he cursed Alexis and her dark progeny. From that day forth, every beam of sunlight to touch a vampire's skin delivers with it a taste of all the suffering inflicted on others. While this causes no physical harm, it induces panic in minds unused to empathy and denies access to the superhuman powers stolen from the souls of others. [PARAGRAPH:1]Lugus always aims for the betterment of those he chastens, but the vampires refused to see his tough love through their own hate. They considered the curse a sign of a vendetta against them, and declared their own vendetta in return. Once Patria fell and could not constrain them, Alexis and Flauros led a campaign to eradicate every soul that honored the God of Truth. His church was destroyed. Every priest was executed. Every holy text was burned. Not one sentence of his doctrine was preserved intact. The Calabim made sure that the church of Lugus could not reemerge for over 600 years. [PARAGRAPH:2]It is however hard to crush the values of the human soul. The Malakim never abandoned their love of truth and openness. From time to time and in many tribes holy men would emerge and espouse such virtues. Lugus himself spoke into the hearts of many of these Lightbrigers. At the start of the Age of Rebirth, the name of Lugus was heard again. When the Once-Elf Varn Gosam wandered into the Desert of Myrh from the Vale of Shadows, he found a faith already emerging. He did not found the Empyrean by converting heathens, but by bringing together those who already loved The Light. Varn had united most of the Malakim in the worship of Lugus before he set out into the deep desert to find the legendary Mirror of Heaven, where Lugus reveled to him his holy doctrines in full.
chinese: “天空”是埃瑞布斯最年轻的主要信仰，仅由其现任大牧首组织而成。然而，对光明之神的崇拜确实古老。曾有一些神庙建于后来成为“迈尔沙漠”之地，它们熬过了诸神之战最惨烈的岁月，却无一挺过魔法纪元。[PARAGRAPH:1]兰瑟斯是人类诸王国首度统一之前时代的一位卢古斯年轻侍僧。他是个正直的男孩，过着为其社群服务的平静生活，直到他遇见艾莉柯西丝的那一天。在她追寻不朽的历程中，她对他犯下了比凡人对凡人所犯过的任何暴行都更为骇人的罪行。她折磨他，超出了一个活着的灵魂所能承受的极限，却不让他死去。当她终于折腾够了、决定放他的灵魂离开肉身时，她却将其吞噬，剥夺了他本应从其神明处得到的永恒安息。卢古斯是一位宽容的主，但即便他的宽容也有限度。他坚持要有真正的悔悟、真诚的痛悔。艾莉柯西丝无论如何也无法在心中生出半分悔意，反而为自己的不义而欣喜，并自豪地将她那黑暗技艺的秘密传授给同样残忍的人。在一切慈悲皆告失败之处，卢古斯认为补足良知是他的职责，于是他诅咒了艾莉柯西丝及其黑暗的子嗣。从那天起，每一缕触及吸血鬼肌肤的阳光，都会随之带来其加诸他人的一切苦难的一丝滋味。这虽不造成肉体伤害，却会在不谙共情的心智中引发恐慌，并阻断其从他人灵魂窃取而来的超凡之力。[PARAGRAPH:1]卢古斯所惩戒者，他向来意在使其向善，但吸血鬼透过自身的仇恨，拒绝看清他这份严厉的爱。他们视此诅咒为一场针对他们的宿怨的标志，转而宣告了他们自己的宿怨作为回应。一旦帕提亚陷落、无力再约束他们，艾莉柯西丝与弗劳诺斯便发动了一场铲除每一个尊奉真理之神的灵魂的运动。他的教会被摧毁。每一位祭司被处决。每一部圣典被焚毁。他教义中没有一句得以完整保存。卡拉比姆确保了卢古斯的教会在六百多年间无法重现。[PARAGRAPH:2]然而，人类灵魂的价值观是难以碾碎的。马拉基姆人从未放弃对真理与开放的热爱。时不时地，在许多部落中，会有圣人涌现、倡导这样的美德。卢古斯本人向许多这样的光明使者的心中低语。重生纪元伊始，卢古斯之名再度被人听闻。当“昔日精灵”范恩·哥萨姆从“暗影之谷”流浪进入迈尔沙漠时，他发现一种信仰已然萌生。他并非通过教化异教徒来创立“天空”，而是通过将那些早已热爱光明之人聚集起来。范恩在深入大漠去寻找传说中的“天堂之镜”之前，便已使大多数马拉基姆人团结于对卢古斯的崇拜之下；在那里，卢古斯向他完整揭示了自己神圣的教义。

english: These demons (also called "Drinkers") consume the souls of their victims, becoming more powerful each time they kill someone. After a few kills the Ira becomes so powerful opponents are better served to hide until they return to normal rather than try to kill it. [LINK=SPELL_ASSUAGE]Calming[\\LINK] spells are very effective against Ira, and weaken them considerably.
chinese: 这些恶魔（又称“饮者”）吞噬其受害者的灵魂，每杀一人便变得更强大。杀掉几人后，恶魔艾尔会变得如此强大，以致对手与其试图杀死它，不如躲藏起来，等它恢复常态。[LINK=SPELL_ASSUAGE]安抚[\\LINK]类法术对艾尔极为有效，能大幅削弱它们。

english: [TAB]The Luchuirp assaulted the Illian city. Juggernauts slammed against the defenses. Towering iron golems waded through the rubble, destroying any defenders they found. The Luchuirp forces tried to stop the ritual that was taking place within the inner city, but they were too late. [PARAGRAPH:1]When Mulcarn entered the city, entered creation, the battle stopped. A layer of ice spread from the first place his foot touched outwards through the city and across the land. The Luchuirp army was destroyed, dwarves killed, golems frozen. Even the Illian macemen were frozen in place, kept unchanged until Mulcarn needed them. [PARAGRAPH:1]As he surveyed his new dominion he picked up one of the Luchuirp golems. He admired their fortitude. They were unaffected by the cold and their unchanging nature. All traits Mulcarn prized. [PARAGRAPH:1]He whispered a new life into the golem, "Make me more. " [PARAGRAPH:1]"As you command" was Barnaxus's reply.
chinese: [TAB]鲁崔尔普人攻打这座伊利安城市。“主宰”重重撞击防御工事。高耸的铁魔像蹚过瓦砾，摧毁它们所发现的任何守军。鲁崔尔普军队试图阻止内城中正在进行的仪式，却为时已晚。[PARAGRAPH:1]当穆尔卡恩进入这座城市、进入造物界时，战斗停止了。一层寒冰从他脚踏之处向外蔓延，穿过城市，遍及大地。鲁崔尔普军队被摧毁，矮人被杀，魔像被冻结。就连伊利安的钉锤兵也被冻在原地，一成不变地留存着，直到穆尔卡恩需要他们。[PARAGRAPH:1]当他审视自己新的领地时，他拾起一个鲁崔尔普魔像。他赞赏它们的坚忍。它们不受寒冷影响，且本性恒定不变。这全是穆尔卡恩所珍视的特质。[PARAGRAPH:1]他向魔像低语了一段新的生命：“为我造出更多。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“遵命。”这是巴纳克苏斯的回答。

english: Illusionists have the abilities of normal mages, and also the abilities granted by the Illusionist promotion. Unlike in base FfH2, this does not make their summons illusions, but instead allows them to create illusionary duplicates of other units nearby. These illusions cannot attack much less kill opponents, but can be quite useful decoys to help defend your real troops.
chinese: 幻术师拥有普通法师的能力，还有“幻术师”晋升所赋予的能力。与原版 FfH2 不同，这并不会使他们的召唤物变成幻象，而是让他们能创造附近其他单位的幻象复制品。这些幻象无法攻击、更无法杀死对手，但可作为相当有用的诱饵，帮助防御你真正的部队。

english: Liches are Archmages who seek immortality through a sort of suicide. They use Necromancy to bind their own souls within their corpses, saving themselves from the horrors of hell, or any afterlife outside Erebus. The Lich's undead form is sustained through magic. Some use spells to preserve their flesh, some cast glamors to maintain the appearance of life, and some prefer to terrify their enemies by opening flaunting their corruption for all to see. Liches are always powerful casters and can be difficult to vanquish. They are naturally immortal, and restore their immortality with every kill. They are immune to all poisons and death damage, strong against unholy, but are vulnerable to holy damage, Undead Slaying, and the Destroy Undead spells. Each player is allowed only one Lich at a time. They must be upgraded from level 8+ units in a city with a Tower of Necromancy.
chinese: 巫妖是通过某种自杀方式追求不朽的大魔法师。他们用死灵术将自己的灵魂束缚于自己的尸体之内，使自己免于地狱、或埃瑞布斯之外任何来世的恐怖。巫妖的亡灵之躯靠魔法维系。有些用法术保存自己的血肉，有些施展幻术以维持生者的外表，有些则偏爱大肆炫耀自己的腐败以令敌人惊惧。巫妖始终是强大的施法者，且难以被击败。他们天生不朽，每杀一人便恢复自身的不朽。他们免疫一切毒素与死亡伤害，对抗邪祟时强大，却易受神圣伤害、“斩杀亡灵”与“毁灭亡灵”法术所害。每位玩家同一时间只允许拥有一个巫妖。他们必须在有“死灵之塔”的城市中，由 8 级以上的单位升级而来。

english: Valkyries were created to battle the demons who were stealing souls undeserving of hell. They escort the claimed to the heavens and attack demons attempting to stop the unclaimed from traveling to Arawn's realm.
chinese: 瓦尔基里被造出来，是为了对抗那些窃取不该下地狱之灵魂的恶魔。她们护送已被认领的灵魂前往天堂，并攻击那些试图阻止未被认领者前往阿劳恩国度的恶魔。

english: The Ophanim are flying chariots manned by angels. They are swift and terrible. Though they fly their wheels still spin with the sound of crunching bones.
chinese: 座天使是由天使驾驭的飞行战车。它们迅捷而可怖。它们虽在飞行，其轮子仍旋转不息，伴着碾碎骨骼的声响。

english: Heralds have the Herald's Call ability, which grants the Herald's Blessing promotion. This is both a blessing and a curse. It makes living units significantly more powerful, but then usually kills them within a few turns. They can return as Angels once they die, but it is still a good idea not to use this spell around units that are more useful alive than dead.
chinese: 守护天使拥有“守护者之召”能力，可授予“守护者祝福”晋升。这既是祝福也是诅咒。它使生命单位显著强大，但通常会在数回合内将其杀死。它们死后可作为天使归来，但对那些活着比死了更有用的单位，最好还是不要在其周围施放此法术。

english: Angelic messengers often used to convey important messages. They convey not only words but usually powerful blessings, for example Nantosuelta may send a Herald to a general that grants valor and strength to his army. Priestesses of Ceridwen have been known to be able to capture and use the blessing of a Herald to their own ends
chinese: 天使信使，常被用来传达重要讯息。它们所传达的不仅是言语，通常还有强大的祝福，例如娜托苏尔塔可能会派一名守护天使前往某位将军处，赐予其军队勇武与力量。克莉德温的女祭司据说能够捕获并将守护天使的祝福用于自己的目的。

english: Maluka
chinese: 玛卢卡

english: Bael
chinese: 巴埃尔

english: Beedle
chinese: 比德尔

english: Gwenhwyfar the Swanmay
chinese: 天鹅少女格温赫维法

english: Bhall's Archangel Brigit can never be built, only [LINK=SPELL_FREE_BRIGIT]freed[\\LINK] from the [LINK=literal]Ring of Carcer[\\LINK] by a level 14+ unit once [LINK=literal]Fanaticism[\\LINK] is known. If Brigit acquires a [LINK=MASK_OF_ESUS]Mask of Esus[\\LINK], she may [LINK=SPELL_RETRIEVE_CORUNDUM_ARDENS]retrieve the Heart of Fire[\\LINK] and transform herself into [LINK=UNIT_SARABRIDE]Sarabride, Goddess of Vengeance[\\LINK], and found The Matronae.
chinese: 巴尔的大天使布里吉特永远无法建造，只能在掌握[LINK=literal]狂热[\\LINK]之后，由 14 级以上的单位从[LINK=literal]卡瑟指环[\\LINK]中[LINK=SPELL_FREE_BRIGIT]解放[\\LINK]出来。若布里吉特获得一具[LINK=MASK_OF_ESUS]杰斯的面具[\\LINK]，她便可[LINK=SPELL_RETRIEVE_CORUNDUM_ARDENS]取回火焰之心[\\LINK]，将自己变为[LINK=UNIT_SARABRIDE]复仇女神萨拉布莱德[\\LINK]，并创立“慈母三神”。

english: Arawn's Archangel Gyra can never be built, only rescued from [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]Bradeline's Well[\\LINK] or summoned using a Mercurian Gate and Death Affinity. If Gyra acquires a [LINK=MASK_OF_ESUS]Mask of Esus[\\LINK], she may [LINK=SPELL_RETRIEVE_OPALUM_MORTIS]retrieve the Ending Stone[\\LINK] and transform herself into [LINK=UNIT_MORRIGAN]Morrigan, Goddess of Fate[\\LINK], and found The Matronae.
chinese: 阿劳恩的大天使吉拉永远无法建造，只能从[LINK=IMPROVEMENT_BRADELINES_WELL]布拉迪来因之井[\\LINK]中解救，或使用“天界之门”与“死亡亲和”召唤。若吉拉获得一具[LINK=MASK_OF_ESUS]杰斯的面具[\\LINK]，她便可[LINK=SPELL_RETRIEVE_OPALUM_MORTIS]取回终结之石[\\LINK]，将自己变为[LINK=UNIT_MORRIGAN]命运女神莫瑞甘[\\LINK]，并创立“慈母三神”。

english: Danalin's Archangel Condatis can never be built, only rescued from [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_AIFON_ISLE]Maenalus[\\LINK]. If Gyra acquires a [LINK=MASK_OF_ESUS]Mask of Esus[\\LINK], she may [LINK=SPELL_RETRIEVE_BERYLLUM_ABYSSI]retrieve the Ocean's Tear[\\LINK] and transform herself into [LINK=UNIT_CLIODNA]Cliodna, Goddess of Dreams[\\LINK], and found The Matronae.
chinese: 达纳林的大天使康达提斯永远无法建造，只能从[LINK=IMPROVEMENT_AIFON_ISLE]梅纳鲁斯[\\LINK]中解救。若吉拉获得一具[LINK=MASK_OF_ESUS]杰斯的面具[\\LINK]，她便可[LINK=SPELL_RETRIEVE_BERYLLUM_ABYSSI]取回海洋之泪[\\LINK]，将自己变为[LINK=UNIT_CLIODNA]梦境女神克莉欧德娜[\\LINK]，并创立“慈母三神”。

english: Aeron's Archangel Odio can never be built, only [LINK=SPELL_FREE_ODIO]freed[\\LINK] from [LINK=literal]Odio's Prison[\\LINK] by a level 11+ unit once [LINK=literal]Rage[\\LINK] is known. Odio and the Ira whom he can summon are vulnerable to the [LINK=literal]Assuage[\\LINK] spell.
chinese: 艾伦的大天使奥迪奥永远无法建造，只能在掌握[LINK=literal]暴怒[\\LINK]之后，由 11 级以上的单位从[LINK=literal]奥迪奥的牢狱[\\LINK]中[LINK=SPELL_FREE_ODIO]解放[\\LINK]出来。奥迪奥以及他能召唤的恶魔艾尔，皆易受[LINK=literal]安抚[\\LINK]法术所害。

english: Ira are special units that may be summoned by the [LINK=UNIT_WRATH]Avatar of Wrath[\\LINK] or created in combat by [LINK=literal]Odio[\\LINK]. Although they start relatively weak, they go stronger whenever they kill an opponent. They are vulnerable to the [LINK=literal]Assuage[\\LINK] spell.
chinese: 恶魔艾尔是特殊单位，可由[LINK=UNIT_WRATH]末日愤怒之灵[\\LINK]召唤，或由[LINK=literal]奥迪奥[\\LINK]在战斗中创造。它们起始时相对弱小，但每杀死一个对手便会变得更强。它们易受[LINK=literal]安抚[\\LINK]法术所害。

english: Chaos Marauders may appear in Sheaim cities with [LINK=BUILDING_PLANAR_GATE]Planar Gates[\\LINK] and [LINK=BUILDING_CARNIVAL]Carnivals[\\LINK], and may be also summoned by the Chaos II spell. The summoned Marauders start out [LINK=literal]Rebellious[\\LINK], difficult to control and likely to betray you to the barbarian state. In either case the unit start out [LINK=literal]Mutated[\\LINK] and are vulnerable to the [LINK=SPELL_ASSUAGE]Assuage[\\LINK] spell.
chinese: 混沌掠夺者可能出现在拥有[LINK=BUILDING_PLANAR_GATE]位面之门[\\LINK]与[LINK=BUILDING_CARNIVAL]狂欢集市[\\LINK]的塞安城市中，也可由“混沌 II”法术召唤。被召唤的掠夺者起始便[LINK=literal]反叛[\\LINK]，难以控制，且很可能背叛你、投向蛮族势力。无论哪种情况，该单位起始便处于[LINK=literal]变异[\\LINK]状态，易受[LINK=SPELL_ASSUAGE]安抚[\\LINK]法术所害。

english: Camulos originally created the Pacales as diplomats and traders. These angels were gifted with the ability to speak and understand any language as their original purpose was to smooth out relations between any intelligent species that may have conflict. That plan didn't last long. Shortly after the Angel of Peace fell to become the God of Strife, these peacemakers reversed their roles and became Chaos Marauders. These demons serve as mercenaries for hire, doing anything within their power to cause strife between various individuals, races, and empires. They still retain the ability to understand any language, but their speech jumps randomly between languages, making it nearly impossible for anyone but other marauders to understand more than small bits of what they are saying.
chinese: 卡穆洛斯最初将“帕卡莱斯”创造为外交官与商人。这些天使被赋予了说与听懂任何语言的能力，因为它们最初的用途是缓和任何可能存在冲突的智慧物种间的关系。那个计划没能持续多久。就在“和平天使”堕落为“纷争之神”后不久，这些缔造和平者反转了自己的角色，成了混沌掠夺者。这些恶魔充当受雇佣兵，竭尽所能地在各色个人、种族与帝国之间制造纷争。它们仍保留着听懂任何语言的能力，但它们的言语会在各种语言之间随机跳跃，使得除了其他掠夺者之外，几乎无人能听懂它们所说的哪怕一小部分。

english: Abashi is among the greatest of Ceridwen's [LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_OBSIDIAN]Obsidian Serpents[\\LINK]. She is not randomly generated from a Wyrmhold lair like her sisters, but may be trained directly by a Sheaim player after the [LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]Stir from Slumber[\\LINK] ritual is completed. Like all [LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_OBSIDIAN]Obsidian Serpents[\\LINK], her [LINK=SPELL_BREATH_NEXUS]breath weapon[\\LINK] is a bean of purple light that most think merely kills its victims, but may actually teleport them to a random location. Her roar transforms [LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC]Dragon Fanatics[\\LINK] to [LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC_OBSIDIAN]Obsidian Serpent Fanatics[\\LINK], as does that of her kin, but unlike them she cannot be compelled to attack a Fanatic's enemies via their [LINK=SPELL_BESEECH_DRAGON]Beseech Dragon[\\LINK] ability.
chinese: 阿巴什是克莉德温最伟大的[LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_OBSIDIAN]黑曜巨蛇[\\LINK]之一。她不像她的姊妹们那样从“蛟龙巢”巢穴中随机生成，而是在“唤醒沉眠”仪式完成后，可由塞安玩家直接[LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]训练[\\LINK]。与所有[LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_OBSIDIAN]黑曜巨蛇[\\LINK]一样，她的[LINK=SPELL_BREATH_NEXUS]吐息武器[\\LINK]是一道紫色光束，多数人以为它只是杀死受害者，实则可能将其传送至随机位置。她的咆哮会将[LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC]巨龙狂信徒[\\LINK]变为[LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC_OBSIDIAN]黑曜巨蛇狂信徒[\\LINK]，她的同类亦然，但与它们不同的是，她无法通过其[LINK=SPELL_BESEECH_DRAGON]恳求巨龙[\\LINK]能力被迫去攻击某狂信徒的敌人。

english: Acheron the Flame Lord is a rebellious creature, not even loyal to his Goddess Bhall much less to mortals who might temporarily subdue him. He is summoned into Erebus by the rage of the barbarians, long before the other dragons awaken. His entry into the world founds the Cult of the Dragon. Most players can only use [LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]Stir from Slumber[\\LINK]to awaken other dragons if they have a city with the religion already present.
chinese: 烈焰领主阿切隆是一头叛逆的造物，就连对他的女神巴尔也谈不上忠诚，更不用说可能暂时制服他的凡人了。他由蛮族的暴怒召入埃瑞布斯，远早于其他巨龙的苏醒。他进入世界便创立了“巨龙教派”。大多数玩家只有在拥有已存在该宗教的城市时，才能用[LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]唤醒沉眠[\\LINK]来唤醒其他巨龙。

english: [PARAGRAPH:1]Drifa the Winter Wyrm [LINK=SPELL_BREATH_FROST]Breathes Frost[\\LINK], which does not summon any unit but can kill entire stacks directly. She was loyal to Mulcarn, but is not easily convinced that this means she should be loyal to Auric Ulvin. She will not serve him before he completes The Draw.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]寒冬蛟龙德瑞法[LINK=SPELL_BREATH_FROST]吐出寒霜[\\LINK]，这不会召唤任何单位，却能直接杀死整堆单位。她曾忠于穆尔卡恩，但并不轻易相信这意味着她就该忠于奥里克·尤尔文。在他完成“抽签”之前，她不会侍奉他。

english: Eurabatres the Gold Dragon was the first of the dragons. Amathaon gave him gift to speak and understand all languages, including being able to speak to plants and animals, the wind, fire, earth and sea. The God of Creation largely stayed out of the Godswar, especially after the fall of the Fathers of Worlds, but Eurabatres continued to lead his armies against the forces of Agares. [PARAGRAPH:1]Since he merged his mind with Cardith Lorda in order to help him find a way to restore his true form, he has become an avatar of said leader. So long as Cardith is alive, he will switch to his control. The death of Eurabatres will cost Cardith his traits, but he can regain them by resurrecting the beast again.
chinese: 金龙尤拉巴崔斯是巨龙中的第一头。阿玛索恩赐予他说与听懂一切语言的天赋，包括能与植物、动物、风、火、大地与海洋对话。创造之神大体上置身于诸神之战之外，尤其是在“世界之父”陨落之后，但尤拉巴崔斯仍继续率领他的军队对抗阿加瑞斯的势力。[PARAGRAPH:1]自从他为帮助卡迪斯·罗达寻得恢复其真身之法而将心神与其融合以来，他便成了这位领袖的化身。只要卡迪斯活着，他便会转由其控制。尤拉巴崔斯之死会使卡迪斯失去其特性，但他可以通过再度复活这头巨兽来重新获得。

english: The Scaled Dragons largely stayed out of the Godswar and were only used to protect the Aifons. Most were locked away at the signing of the Compact, but Thalatth was awakened to protect Maenalus again when in the Age of Magic it seemed Danalin's favorite people were in trouble. He was a gentle beast before, but witnessing whatever horror that destroyed the Aifons has driven him insane and hard to control. You can train him in Cult of the Dragon cities under the Undertow state religion, but doing so will drive your Scaled Dragon fanatics crazy too.
chinese: 鳞龙大体上置身于诸神之战之外，只被用来保护艾丰人。大多数在《契约》签订时被封锁起来，但塔拉斯在魔法纪元、达纳林最钟爱的族人似乎陷入危难时，被唤醒以再度保护梅纳鲁斯。他从前是头温柔的巨兽，但目睹了那毁灭艾丰人的、不知为何的恐怖之后，他被逼疯，难以控制。你可以在以“暗流”为国教的“巨龙教派”城市中训练他，但这么做也会把你的鳞龙狂信徒逼疯。

english: [TAB]Orthus, the self styled King of the Barbarians Hordes, is the most brutal and dangerous of the Orcish warlords. It is rumored that he was once a Bannor nobleman and close friend to King Khorde NuValle of Old Braduk before the Fall of Bhall, but there is no nobility or humanity left in this monster today. Even the Clan of Embers is far too civilized for him. He despises even their crude attempts at culture and scorns their loyalty to a goddess he considers as good as dead. While they revere their Bhall-Orcs, he would rather exterminate the whole priestly line. He already murdered the entire family of the last high priestess (except for one small orphan boy named Rantine, who managed to escape and devoted his life to opposing Orthus) in his quest to acquire the Matron Essendi. He then defiled this most sacred scepter by hafting it to a crude battle axe, which became a legendary weapon that fills its user with enough passion to fight on long past the point of exhaustion. [PARAGRAPH:1]Despite his barbarism, Orthus remains both very Charismatic and very Cunning. When he is created the Barbarian leader gains the Charismatic, Ingenuity, and Arrogating traits, which are then lost when he is killed.
chinese: [TAB]自封为“蛮族大军之王”的俄耳托斯，是兽人军阀中最残暴、最危险的一个。有传闻说，在巴尔陨落之前，他曾是一位班诺尔贵族，是古布拉杜克国王霍德·努拔鲁的密友，但如今这怪物身上已不剩半分高贵或人性。就连“余灰部落”对他而言也太过文明。他鄙视他们对文明哪怕粗陋的尝试，也蔑视他们对一位他视同已死的女神的忠诚。他们尊崇他们的“巴尔兽人”，他却宁愿把整条祭司血脉赶尽杀绝。在他攫取“圣母权杖”的过程中，他已经谋杀了末代高阶女祭司的全家（唯有一个名叫兰泰恩的孤儿小男孩例外，他设法逃脱，并终其一生都在与俄耳托斯为敌）。随后他玷污了这最神圣的权杖，将其嵌接在一柄粗陋的战斧上，那斧子成了一件传奇武器，为其使用者注入足够的激情，令其在精疲力竭之后仍能久战不休。[PARAGRAPH:1]尽管野蛮，俄耳托斯仍既极具魅力又极为狡黠。他被创造时，蛮族领袖会获得“魅力”、“巧思”与“僭夺”特性，这些特性会在他被杀死时失去。

english: [TAB]I was born to end an age of destruction. Dragons, angels, Leviathans, the mighty armies of the gods clashed as they struggled for advantage. Below, the earth trembled, and man was locked into a terrifying existence he could not hope to comprehend. [PARAGRAPH:1]The gods agreed on but one thing--that should they continue their struggle in the same vein or all their work would be lost. The spoils of their war, those sentient beings born of their cooperation at the time of creation, would be destroyed if an agreement was not made. [PARAGRAPH:1]So they came, one by one, to a distant corner of Erebus, until all 21 were assembled. The agreement was made, spelled out to the letter. I was the manifest symbol of that covenant, and its enforcement. The Godslayer. [PARAGRAPH:1]The oath each god made in turn bound their fate to me. As they spoke their agreement, their name became etched onto my surface. Then they left, never to set foot personally in creation again, on pain of death. I was left in the care of a human warrior. Centuries past. My purpose was forgotten--the Godslayer was used in battles and wars as any other blade. My pieces were split apart from use and time, but my nature cannot be destroyed. [PARAGRAPH:1]Mulcarn breaks his vow. Take me to him, for he has forfeit his life, and is sentenced to die upon my blade. Take me to him.
chinese: [TAB]我生来是为了终结一个毁灭的时代。巨龙、天使、深海巨兽、诸神威武的大军，为争夺优势而彼此冲撞。下方，大地震颤，人类被困于一种他们无从理解的可怖存在之中。[PARAGRAPH:1]诸神只在一件事上达成了一致——倘若他们继续以同样的方式斗争下去，他们所有的心血都将付诸东流。他们战争的战利品，那些在创世之初由他们协作而诞生的有灵存在，若不达成协议，便将被毁灭。[PARAGRAPH:1]于是他们一个接一个地来到埃瑞布斯一个遥远的角落，直到全部二十一位齐聚。协议达成，逐字逐句地写明。我便是那盟约的实体象征，也是其执行者。弑神者。[PARAGRAPH:1]每位神明依次立下的誓言，将他们的命运与我绑定。当他们道出自己的约定时，他们的名字便镌刻在我的表面。然后他们离去，永不再亲身踏足造物界，违者处死。我被托付给一名人类战士看管。数百年过去。我的用途被人遗忘——弑神者像任何别的刀剑一样被用于战斗与战争。因使用与岁月，我的各个部分被拆散，但我的本质无法被摧毁。[PARAGRAPH:1]穆尔卡恩背弃了他的誓言。带我去见他，因为他已断送了自己的性命，注定要死于我的剑下。带我去见他。

english: The Crusader are an excellent counter for your opponent's Demonic units. Not only do they get a strength bonus against demons, but they are immune to disease, making them perfect to send into an area to eliminate any diseases The Ashen Veil and their Diseased Corpses have spread. [PARAGRAPH]There is a chance that a Crusader will automatically spread his religion to any city he conquers. The spread of The Order can cause more Crusaders to join your cause, and can also purge The Ashen Veil and The Undertow from the city.
chinese: 十字军是克制对手恶魔单位的绝佳选择。他们不仅对抗恶魔时获得战斗力加成，还免疫疾病，因而非常适合派往某地区，清除“混沌之灰烬”及其尸妖所散播的任何疾病。[PARAGRAPH]十字军有一定几率将其宗教自动传播到他所征服的任何城市。“秩序”的传播可招来更多十字军加入你的阵营，也能清除城中的“混沌之灰烬”与“暗流”。

english: Manes have a chance of being automatically created when an evil* unit dies or a neutral or evil city** is razed. They are gifted to [LINK=CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL]Infernal[\\LINK] civilizations and may be upgraded to most units. More importantly, they can also be [LINK=SPELL_ADD_TO_CITY]sacrificed to add population to a city[\\LINK]. Doing this transforms their experience into [ICON_CULTURE] and [ICON_PRODUCTION] for the city, and spreads their religion to said city. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]*Evil units include those with the [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]Ashen Veil[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]Council of Esus[\\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]The Undertow[\\LINK], or [LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]White Hand[\\LINK] *** religion, those which practice [LINK=PROMOTION_DEATH1]Undeath[\\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_DIMENSIONAL1]Dimensional[\\LINK], or [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY1]Entropy[\\LINK] magic, those with the [LINK=PROMOTION_VAMPIRE]Vampire[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]Unholy Taint[\\LINK] promotion and those which are [LINK=PROMOTION_POSSESSED]Demon possessed[\\LINK]. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]**Whether razing a city generates Manes depends on both the alignment of its owner and on the alignment of the religions worshiped there. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]***Note that after [LINK=UNIT_AURIC]Auric Ulvin[\\LINK] [LINK=PROJECT_ASCENSION]Ascends[\\LINK], units and city population of The White Hand religion will return as Manes under the control of the new [LINK=UNIT_AURIC_ASCENDED]God of Winter[\\LINK] rather than being gifted to the Infernals.
chinese: 当一个邪恶*单位死亡，或一座中立或邪恶的城市**被摧毁时，恶灵有几率被自动创造。它们被赐予[LINK=CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL]地狱[\\LINK]文明，可升级为大多数单位。更重要的是，它们还可被[LINK=SPELL_ADD_TO_CITY]牺牲以为城市增加人口[\\LINK]。这么做会将它们的经验转化为城市的 [ICON_CULTURE] 与 [ICON_PRODUCTION]，并将它们的宗教传播到该城。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]*邪恶单位包括那些信奉[LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]混沌之灰烬[\\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]杰斯议会[\\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_OCTOPUS_OVERLORDS]暗流[\\LINK]或[LINK=RELIGION_WHITE_HAND]白手[\\LINK]***宗教者，那些施展[LINK=PROMOTION_DEATH1]亡灵术[\\LINK]、[LINK=PROMOTION_DIMENSIONAL1]次元[\\LINK]或[LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY1]熵[\\LINK]魔法者，那些拥有[LINK=PROMOTION_VAMPIRE]吸血鬼[\\LINK]或[LINK=PROMOTION_UNHOLY_TAINT]邪祟污染[\\LINK]晋升者，以及那些被[LINK=PROMOTION_POSSESSED]恶魔附身[\\LINK]者。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]**摧毁一座城市是否生成恶灵，既取决于其拥有者的阵营，也取决于其中所信奉宗教的阵营。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]***注意，在[LINK=UNIT_AURIC]奥里克·尤尔文[\\LINK][LINK=PROJECT_ASCENSION]飞升[\\LINK]之后，“白手”宗教的单位与城市人口将作为恶灵、受新任[LINK=UNIT_AURIC_ASCENDED]寒冬之神[\\LINK]控制而归来，而非被赐予地狱军团。

english: Angels may be awarded to the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MERCURIANS]Mercurians[\\LINK] whenever good people die. This could be from a "good"* unit being killed, in which case they are made into an angel and maintain their experience to spend on new skills, or when a "good" city** is razed. Angels are the only units that can be upgraded into the Mercurians' most powerful units, so a healthy supply is crucial to their conquest of Erebus. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]*Good units are those who follow the [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ORDER]Order[\\LINK], the [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]Empyrean[\\LINK], or the [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]Runes of Kilmorph[\\LINK] religion, have the Herald's Blessing promotion, or are controlled by Basium's team. It excludes animals and beast units. Note that things that make a unit qualify as evil take precedence over those that make it good; Empyrean units using death magic or Mercurian units of the [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]Council of Esus[\\LINK] religion would return as [LINK=CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL]Infernal[\\LINK] [LINK=UNIT_MANES]Manes[\\LINK] rather than Mercurian Angels. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]**Whether razing a city generates Angels depends on both the alignment of its owner and on the alignment of the religions worshiped there.
chinese: 每当善良之人死去，天使便可能被授予[LINK=CIVILIZATION_MERCURIANS]天界军团[\\LINK]。这可能是因为一个“善良”*单位被杀死——此时它会被变为天使，并保留其经验以用于习得新技能——或是当一座“善良”城市**被摧毁时。天使是唯一能升级为天界军团最强大单位的单位，因此充足的供应对他们征服埃瑞布斯至关重要。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]*善良单位是指那些信奉[LINK=RELIGION_THE_ORDER]秩序[\\LINK]、[LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]天空[\\LINK]或[LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]基鲁莫夫之痕[\\LINK]宗教者、拥有“守护者祝福”晋升者，或由铁锤巴希姆队伍控制者。它不包括动物与野兽单位。注意，使单位符合邪恶资格的因素优先于使其符合善良资格的因素；使用死亡魔法的“天空”单位，或信奉[LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]杰斯议会[\\LINK]宗教的天界军团单位，将作为[LINK=CIVILIZATION_INFERNAL]地狱[\\LINK][LINK=UNIT_MANES]恶灵[\\LINK]、而非天界天使归来。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]**摧毁一座城市是否生成天使，既取决于其拥有者的阵营，也取决于其中所信奉宗教的阵营。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Angels of Death are excellent countermeasures to the [LINK=PROMOTION_UNDEAD]Undead[\\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_IMMORTAL]Immortals[\\LINK], and [LINK=PROMOTION_VAMPIRE]Vampires[\\LINK]. [NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]The moral sort of [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_DEATH_ARAWN]Death Affinity[\\LINK] lets them cast [LINK=SPELL_DESTROY_UNDEAD]Destroy Undead[\\LINK] and [LINK=SPELL_HALLOW_GRAVEYARD]Hallow Graves[\\LINK]. [NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]They defend first against various Undead, and can target immortals when attacking. [NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]Their touch removes Immortality from any Living or Undead units that has found a way to cheat Arawn (or Laroth) of his due. [NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]Cities they attack have their populations reduced. [NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]Each source of [LINK=BONUS_MANA_DEATH]Death Mana[\\LINK] their plot's owner controls grants them a free promotion pick. [NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]Angels of Death are [LINK=PROMOTION_INVISIBLE]Invisible[\\LINK] and capable of investigating rival cities.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]死亡天使是对抗[LINK=PROMOTION_UNDEAD]亡灵[\\LINK]、[LINK=PROMOTION_IMMORTAL]不朽战士[\\LINK]与[LINK=PROMOTION_VAMPIRE]吸血鬼[\\LINK]的绝佳手段。[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]其合乎道德的那种[LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_DEATH_ARAWN]死亡亲和[\\LINK]，让它们能施放[LINK=SPELL_DESTROY_UNDEAD]毁灭亡灵[\\LINK]与[LINK=SPELL_HALLOW_GRAVEYARD]圣化墓地[\\LINK]。[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]它们对各类亡灵优先防御，攻击时能锁定不朽战士。[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]它们的触碰会从任何找到办法欺瞒阿劳恩（或拉洛斯）应得之份的生命或亡灵单位身上移除不朽。[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]它们所攻击的城市，人口会被削减。[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]其所在地块的拥有者每掌控一处[LINK=BONUS_MANA_DEATH]死亡能量[\\LINK]来源，便授予它们一次免费的晋升选择。[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET]死亡天使[LINK=PROMOTION_INVISIBLE]隐形[\\LINK]，能够查探敌方城市。

english: One may not escape the angel of death, nor say to him, 'Wait until I put my affairs in order,' or 'There is my son, my slave: take him in my stead. ' Where the angel of death appears there is no remedy. [PARAGRAPH:0]These 'Angels of Death' are the Dullahan, mere servants of The Angel of Death, Arawn. He is a benevolent god, although always very dour. When The One gave The Twenty-One the power of creation, he commanded them that all their works were to be temporary, for they were not capable of making creatures perfect enough to endure the burden of true immortality. While Mankind condemns Agares as the creator of Evil, if was Nemed who first convinced his brethren to sin. Beholden to the precept of Life, he was willing to sacrifice his godhood to become the first man but unwilling to surrender his immortality. He convinced his brethren to create his wife Gabella as the crowning glory of Creation, a powerful and truly immortal woman who would bear him an immortal progeny. Arawn disliked this plan and cautioned against defying The One's wishes, but eventually agreed to abide by the majority decision. This proved disastrous. [PARAGRAPH]Once it was clear that Os-Gabella would bear no sons, the gods created Anesidora to take her place. This time the gods agreed to make humanity mortal, but they still insisted on granting us immortal souls. Arawn (who by then embodied the Precept of Life as well as Death) volunteered to tend to these disembodied spirits, granting them refuse and rest in his vault. He chose to let them choose their own fates, fashioning their own worlds within his just as the subconscious minds generates dreams. Arawn neither rewards nor punishes, but gives each soul what he believes he deserves. [PARAGRAPH]At first mankind recognized the gift of death as a welcome mortality from the weariness of life. In those early days, death was rare and experienced only by those who had lived a full life. The horrors of the Godswar and of the sorcery of the Age of Magic changed this greatly. The evil gods did much to make death more common, and more feared. Men terrified of the next world committed atrocities in order to bind their souls to this one. By the time of The Compact the gods had learned that souls were a valuable commodity, which they could use to create armies of angels and demons in order to increase their own power. Arawn alone abstained from this. He continued to take in more souls than any other god, but refused to exploit them for his own purposes. [PARAGRAPH]Arawn abhors the perversions of Undeath. It was for this reason that he create The Dullahan. During the Age of Magic he would send out these True Angels to gather souls and guide them to their resting place, lest they be stolen by other gods or bound to their own decaying flesh. [PARAGRAPH]Once he surrendered the Precept of Life to Sucellus, the God of Death withdrew further into himself. He now refuses to have anything to do with Erebus, and will scarcely acknowledge that it exists. The armies of the Dullahan still long to fulfill their purpose, but cannot do so in his service. While many still follow Gyra, the Archangel of their sphere, many others have abandoned their god in order to serve in the armies of her twin. Others have taken an even darker path and are determined to help Laroth destroy Arawn so that they can follow a god who will lead the dead to conquer the lands of the living. [PARAGRAPH:3]Faeryl Viconia and Barbatos plot to summon Gyra, the Archangel of Death. Faeryl plans to command Gyra to kill Arendel, the queen of the Summer Court, and Barbatos wants Gyra to remove the curse Arawn has placed upon him and end his own life. [PARAGRAPH]Though their ritual is exhaustive and requires sacrifice from both of them, it does not summon or bind Gyra herself. Instead one of the Dullahan, servants of the Norns, is trapped by their spell. His name is Dumah and he is the spirit of silence and the stillness of death. [PARAGRAPH]The Dullahan are charged with ending immortal life, but even they can't end Arawn's curse on Barbatos. Faeryl still turns the Dullahan against Arendel. The Dullahan slips into the Summer Court capital on the Winter Solstice, when the city is usually quiet. He walks unhindered through the city, guards unknowingly deciding to check other posts, and the few citizens on the street unknowingly taking other routes as their instincts guide them to avoid Dumah's path. [PARAGRAPH]Dumah sits for a season in the throne room of Arendel, and though he stands in the room no one notices him. They look away as he watches the beautiful queen rule her kingdom with honor and passion. He sees her cry for her empire's losses when she thinks the throne room is empty, and feels the weight of ages of hard decisions upon her. He also witnesses her fierce strength and resolve in leading her people. [PARAGRAPH]Knowing her guards will sacrifice themselves to protect her, that he will kill those guards, and the weight of those useless deaths on Arendel, Dumah waits until the palace is quiet and the queen is alone. Then he casts back his cloak and appears to her as an angel of death, radiating with ancient power, immutable and eternal. [PARAGRAPH]Dumah calls to Arendel, telling her of the great love he has for her, but commanding that her time is ended; this eternal life is not meant for mortals. She cannot escape death. [PARAGRAPH]Arendel's ring summons her personal guard to her. Devon, an elven warrior and direct son of Nemed, attacks the Dullahan. Though Devon is strong and blessed with holy power, he does not injure the Dullahan. Instead the Dullahan strikes Devon, leaving him broken and dying on the throne room floor. [PARAGRAPH]Arendel pleads with Dumah. She offers to give up her immortality, to let death come for her as it will, but not on this night. The Dullahan should retreat and return for her when death comes naturally for her. Dumah agrees. [PARAGRAPH]Arendel restores Devon by passing him the Phoenix with which Sucellus had blessed her. This provides the Son of Nemed with the health, strength, and eternal youth she had enjoyed for ages. Arendel gives him the ring that she used to summon him, releasing him from her charge. He has given his life for her once; she can ask no more from him. [PARAGRAPH]Dumah retreats, staying hidden but always close to the summer queen, watching her finally begin to age as the seasons pass, and waiting for the moment they will meet again.
chinese: “无人能逃脱死亡天使，也无人能对他说：‘等我把事务安排妥当’，或‘这是我的儿子、我的奴仆：带他替我去吧。’”死亡天使现身之处，别无良方。[PARAGRAPH:0]这些“死亡天使”是杜拉汉，不过是死亡天使阿劳恩的仆从。他是一位仁慈的神明，尽管总是十分阴郁。当“太一”将创造之力赐予“二十一神”时，他命令他们的一切造物都须是暂时的，因为他们无力造出足够完美、能承受真正不朽之重负的生灵。世人虽谴责阿加瑞斯为邪恶的创造者，但最先说服其同侪犯罪的却是奈梅德。他受制于“生命”的箴规，甘愿牺牲自己的神性以成为第一个人，却不愿交出自己的不朽。他说服其同侪创造出他的妻子加贝拉，作为造物界的登峰之作——一个强大而真正不朽的女子，将为他诞下不朽的子嗣。阿劳恩不喜这一计划，告诫众人不可违逆“太一”的意愿，但最终还是同意遵从多数人的决定。这被证明是灾难性的。[PARAGRAPH]一旦明确奥斯·加贝拉不会诞下任何子嗣，诸神便创造了安妮西朵拉来取代她。这一次诸神同意让人类成为凡人，但他们仍坚持赐予我们不朽的灵魂。阿劳恩（那时他已同时承载了生命与死亡的箴规）自愿照料这些无形之灵，在他的宝库中赐予它们庇护与安息。他选择让它们自行选择各自的命运，在他的宝库之内自行营造它们自己的世界，正如潜意识生成梦境一般。阿劳恩既不奖赏也不惩罚，而是给予每个灵魂他认为其应得之物。[PARAGRAPH]起初，人类将死亡的馈赠视为从生之疲惫中解脱的、可喜的凡人之限。在那些早年岁月里，死亡罕见，只有活满一生的人才会经历。诸神之战的恐怖与魔法纪元的巫术，极大地改变了这一点。邪恶的诸神竭力使死亡更为常见、更令人惧怕。惧怕来世的人们，为将自己的灵魂束缚于今世而犯下暴行。到《契约》之时，诸神已明白灵魂是一种宝贵的商品，他们能用它来创造天使与恶魔的军队，以增强自身的力量。唯有阿劳恩不为此所动。他继续比任何其他神明接纳更多的灵魂，却拒绝为自己的目的利用它们。[PARAGRAPH]阿劳恩憎恶亡灵术的种种堕落。正因如此，他创造了杜拉汉。在魔法纪元，他会派出这些真天使去收集灵魂、引导它们前往安息之所，以免它们被其他神明窃取、或被束缚于它们自己腐朽的血肉之中。[PARAGRAPH]一旦他将“生命”的箴规交予苏塞卢斯，死亡之神便更深地退隐于自身之中。他如今拒绝与埃瑞布斯有任何瓜葛，甚至几乎不肯承认它的存在。杜拉汉的军队仍渴望履行它们的使命，却无法在他的麾下这么做。虽然许多仍追随其领域的大天使吉拉，另有许多却抛弃了自己的神，转而在她孪生姊妹的军队中效力。还有一些走上了更为黑暗的道路，决意帮助拉洛斯毁灭阿劳恩，好让它们能追随一位将带领亡者征服生者之地的神明。[PARAGRAPH:3]菲尔蕾尔·维康莉亚与巴巴托斯密谋召唤死亡大天使吉拉。菲尔蕾尔打算命令吉拉杀死“夏之宫廷”的女王阿伦德尔，而巴巴托斯则想让吉拉解除阿劳恩加诸他身上的诅咒、终结他自己的性命。[PARAGRAPH]尽管他们的仪式详尽繁复、需要二人皆作出牺牲，它却并未召唤或束缚吉拉本人。取而代之，一名杜拉汉——诺恩三女神的仆从——被他们的法术困住。他名叫杜玛，是寂静与死亡之静止的灵。[PARAGRAPH]杜拉汉受命终结不朽的生命，但即便是他们也无法解除阿劳恩加诸巴巴托斯的诅咒。菲尔蕾尔仍将这杜拉汉引向阿伦德尔。杜拉汉在冬至那天溜进“夏之宫廷”的都城，那时城中通常一片寂静。他在城中畅行无阻，卫兵们不知何故都决定去查看别的岗哨，街上少数的市民也不知不觉地改走别的路线，仿佛本能引导他们避开杜玛的路径。[PARAGRAPH]杜玛在阿伦德尔的王座厅中枯坐了一整季，尽管他就站在厅中，却无人注意到他。他注视着这位美丽的女王以荣誉与激情统治她的王国时，众人都把目光移开。他看见她在以为王座厅空无一人时，为她帝国的损失而落泪，也感受到岁月里种种艰难抉择压在她身上的重负。他还见证了她领导人民时那凶猛的坚强与决心。[PARAGRAPH]杜玛知道她的卫兵会舍身护她，知道他将杀死那些卫兵，也知道那些无谓的死亡会给阿伦德尔带来的重负，于是他一直等到宫殿寂静、女王独处之时。然后他甩开斗篷，以死亡天使之姿现身于她面前，散发着古老的力量，不可更易，亘古长存。[PARAGRAPH]杜玛呼唤阿伦德尔，告诉她自己对她怀有的深爱，却命令她的时限已到；这永恒的生命本不为凡人而设。她无法逃脱死亡。[PARAGRAPH]阿伦德尔的指环将她的私人卫队召至她身边。德文——一名精灵战士、奈梅德的直系之子——攻击这杜拉汉。尽管德文强壮、且蒙受神圣之力祝福，他却伤不了这杜拉汉分毫。相反，杜拉汉一击将德文击倒，令他破碎、垂死地躺在王座厅的地板上。[PARAGRAPH]阿伦德尔恳求杜玛。她提出放弃自己的不朽，任凭死亡随时来临，但不要在今夜。杜拉汉应当退去，待死亡自然临到她时再来接她。杜玛同意了。[PARAGRAPH]阿伦德尔将苏塞卢斯曾祝福她的凤凰传给德文，使他复原。这为这位奈梅德之子带来了她曾享有多年的健康、力量与永恒的青春。阿伦德尔把她用来召唤他的那枚指环给了他，解除了他对她的效命之责。他已为她献出过一次生命；她无法再向他索求更多。[PARAGRAPH]杜玛退去，始终隐匿却总在这位夏之女王近旁，看着她终于随季节流转而开始衰老，等待着他们再度相逢的那一刻。

english: A wyvern is a large flying serpent with a tail ending in a scorpion's stinger. They are rare in the Age of Rebirth, having been hunted almost to extinction by knights responding to reports of them stealing livestock or threatening rural families. They were much more common during the wars of the Age of Magic, when the students of Kezef and Leucetios created them as a poor imitation of true dragons.
chinese: 翼龙是一种巨大的飞行毒蛇，尾部末端长有蝎子般的毒针。它们在重生纪元十分稀有，因偷袭牲畜或威胁乡间人家的报告，遭骑士几乎猎杀殆尽。在魔法纪元的战争中它们要常见得多，那时凯泽夫与卢凯提俄斯的门徒将它们创造出来，作为对真龙的拙劣仿制。

english: Wyvern Rider
chinese: 翼龙骑手

english: Wyverns are powerful winged serpents created by human archmages in the Age of Magic. Few survive in the Age of Rebirth.
chinese: 翼龙是魔法纪元由人类大魔法师创造的强大有翼毒蛇。在重生纪元幸存者寥寥。

english: Gibbon Goetia is a [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANGELING]changeling[\\LINK] who can takes the form and abilities of those he kills. (Due to potential complications in the code, this ability does not work on animals, beasts, or those units that will abandon players who do not maintain the right civic or state religion. ) If you use his to target stronger opponents, he will himself become stronger. Should the form he assumes seem inferior to his natural state, you may use his [LINK=SPELL_ASSUME_TRUE_FORM]Assume True Form[\\LINK] ability to get rid of the disadvantage.
chinese: 大法师吉本·哥地亚是一个[LINK=PROMOTION_CHANGELING]换生灵[\\LINK]，能变成他所杀之人的形态与能力。（因代码中潜在的复杂问题，此能力对动物、野兽，或那些会在你不维持相应政策或国教时弃你而去的单位无效。）若你用他去锁定更强的对手，他自己也会变得更强。倘若他所化的形态似乎逊于他的本来状态，你可用他的[LINK=SPELL_ASSUME_TRUE_FORM]化回真身[\\LINK]能力来摆脱这一劣势。
